A great dental nurse can transform a patient’s day. Come and make a difference with us.
Are you ready to step into a new challenge in a friendly, modern setting? We’re looking for a Dental Nurse to join our welcoming team at The Smile Rooms in Malton.
The role at a glance:
• Part-time hours: 22.5 hours per week
• Typical shifts: 7.5 hours per day, worked across Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, between our opening hours of 7:45am–7:00pm, with one Saturday shift per month.

• Located in the heart of the market town of Malton

We’d love to receive your application to our Dental Nurse vacancy if you have the following skills and experience:
• A recognised Dental Nursing qualification and active GDC registration
• A positive and empathetic approach, with strong communication skills

Location: Corby, Northamptonshire
Salary: £29,020 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am – 5:00pm

About the role
We’re looking for a Warehouse Training Coordinator to join our team in Corby.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with people, keeping things organised and helping colleagues develop the skills they need to be successful in a busy warehouse environment.
You’ll coordinate and support training across the operation, making sure colleagues receive the right training at the right time and that training records are kept accurate and up to date.
You don't need to be an experienced trainer or have a formal L&D background. We're looking for someone who is organised, confident communicating with people and comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse environment and likes to 'show someone the ropes'.
What you'll be doing
•
Coordinate and schedule training for new and existing warehouse colleagues.
•
Support the onboarding and induction of new starters.
•
Work closely with warehouse managers and team leaders to identify training requirements.
•
Arrange training sessions and ensure colleagues are available to attend.
•
Maintain accurate training records and ensure mandatory training is completed.
•
Monitor training completion and follow up where required.
•
Support trainers and operational teams with the delivery of warehouse training.
•
Help ensure colleagues are trained and competent before carrying out relevant tasks independently.
•
Provide support and guidance to colleagues throughout their training.
•
Identify any training gaps and escalate these to the relevant manager.
•
Produce basic reports and updates on training activity.
•
Help maintain training materials and documentation.
•
Build positive relationships with colleagues across the warehouse operation.

Qualifications
What we're looking for
We're looking for someone who is organised, approachable and confident working with people.
You'll ideally have:
•
Experience working in a warehouse, logistics or operational environment.
•
Previous experience coordinating training, inductions or onboarding.
•
Good organisational and time-management skills.
•
Confidence communicating with colleagues at all levels.
•
The ability to manage multiple training activities and deadlines.
•
Good attention to detail, particularly when maintaining records.
•
A positive and supportive approach to helping others learn.
•
Good basic IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
•
The confidence to work independently while also being part of a wider team.
Why join Arvato?
At Arvato, you'll be joining a growing operation where there are opportunities to develop your skills and build a long-term career.
This role would suit someone who enjoys working with people and operations and wants to develop their experience in training and development within a busy logistics environment.
You'll have the opportunity to work closely with operational teams, gain valuable experience in warehouse training and play an important role in helping our colleagues develop and succeed.

To lead value creation and transformation across Masdar’s portfolio, establishing a sustained capability to identify, prioritise and deliver performance improvement opportunities across the platforms. The role holder will lead recurring value creation sprints, develop value creation plans for existing businesses and new project acquisitions, and drive the continued evolution of Masdar’s operating model in alignment with strategic priorities.

Operating Model Implementation & Integration
• Lead implementation of Masdar's operating model and value creation approach, including governance, sequencing, key milestones and decision forums
• Coordinate cross-platform and cross-functional dependencies, risks and decisions, escalating material issues and driving timely resolution
• Lead change management, communications and adoption of new ways of working
• Maintain a practical integration playbook for future acquisitions and platform integrations
• Evolve the operating model as the portfolio grows, ensuring continued alignment with Masdar’s strategic priorities, Group direction and business needs
Portfolio Value Creation & Performance
• Own the ongoing portfolio value creation agenda, maintaining a prioritised pipeline of initiatives aligned with platform and Group objectives
• Lead recurring value creation sprints with platform and functional teams to identify, assess and mobilise performance improvement opportunities, e.g., pre-FID capex optimisation sprints
• Develop value creation plans for existing businesses and new project or platform acquisitions, working with investment, M&A, finance and operational teams from due diligence through delivery
• Maintain aligned position of benefits tracking vs baseline between workstream owners, platform leads, and finance gate-keepers for platforms throughout transformation

• Coordinate functional inputs and interdependencies to keep delivery aligned to the integrated master plan and agreed timelines

Compliance with standards and forms
• Apply consistent approaches/discipline and standardized forms in line with relevant policies, processes and procedures.
Preparation of relevant updates and reports
• Prepare relevant reports and updates as required and to the desired standard.
• Provide management information as and when required by the line manager – this includes the production and timely provision of accurate reports in line with reporting schedules.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in business, finance, engineering or a related field required

About This Job
At AECOM one of our key business lines is Bridges and Structures which is currently expanding due to a number of recent high-profile project wins which will be added to our already impressive portfolio. We are looking for ambitious, hardworking, enthusiastic Civil & Structural Engineering graduates who have computational, mathematical and design skills. Candidates will work on a variety of projects from concept design to implementation for clients who operate either locally, nationally or internationally. Those selected will have to be focused on delivery of results to our clients whilst finding enjoyment in technically challenging projects.
As leaders in the sector, our Bridges and Structures teams provide wide challenging opportunities in an ever-evolving industry. Our undisputable global position could give you the chance to work in the design of UK or international projects between our London, Madrid, Italy, United States and the Middle East offices; undertake the assessment and maintenance of the current UK bridge network, or propose renewal structural works for the current UK bridge network. With both international and domestic clients, we are committed to providing quality, innovative and sustainable solutions using the latest technology in civil & structural engineering whilst taking advantage of our integrated range of services by collaborating with other disciplines within AECOM. Excellence, agility, perseverance, communication, forward-thinking and global awareness are some of the skills that our daily work demands from our teams in order to maintain and enhance our relationship with our clients and stakeholders as competition in the market grows harder.
Recent projects include: Edmonton Capital Line Network Arch Bridge, Canada; Jodrell Bank Telescope; Portage Bay, United States; New Alperton Foot and Cycle Bridge; Panama Canal New Arch Bridge, Panama; Civil Assessment Framework Agreement (CAFA); 10 Dock upgrade at Devonport Dockyard; London Bridge Assessment, Tower Bridge Motor Replacement, Blackfriars Bridge Painting and Refurbishment.

Successful candidates will use industry leading computer software while working on a variety of different bridge specific expertise including:
• Structural Design
• Bridge Assessment
• Finite Elements Analysis
• Structural Inspections
• Structures Renewal Feasibility Studies
• On-site Works Supervision
• Scheme Management
Graduates will be expected to contribute to the design of structures from inception to completion, undertake the assessment of existing structures throughout the different stages such as on-site inspection and analysis, or manage the resources and tasks within a scheme of structures. AECOM is committed to the development of our graduates providing mobility between different projects and gradually increasing the level of responsibility within the firm.

Qualifications
• BEng in Civil or Structural Engineering, with a 2:1 classification (or equivalent) or above
• MEng or MSc in Civil or Structural Engineering would be an advantage
• Structural modules or Structural/Bridge Engineering experience would be an advantage
• Ability to demonstrate a good technical understanding of Civil & Structural Engineering
• Demonstrable interest in Bridge Structures Engineering and developing a career in this industry

• Good Microsoft Office skills essential such as Word, Excel & PowerPoint
• Ability to communicate effectively to internal and external clients, both verbally & in writing with the confidence to engage with a variety of people (clients, colleagues, stakeholders and sub-contractors alike) and the aptitude to rationally explain, explore and discuss technical issues and capture feedback
• Enthusiastic, hard-working, with ambition and drive
• Ability to structure & prioritise work effectively through close cooperation with the team as a whole
• Ability to work in a team and independently without losing initiative & focus.

Additional Information
• Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected on a rolling recruitment basis for either immediate or advanced offer start.
• Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades and details of the dates you are able to work to/from and well as locations you would be interested in.
• We support a hybrid working model, with colleagues typically attending the office 3-5 days per week to foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and on-the-job learning
• You must have the right to work in the UK.

About This Job

Are you looking to your clinical skills in a different way? As a Functional Assessor, you'll continue to utilise your clinical expertise, maintain your registration, and enjoy a better work-life balance. If you have a minimum of 12 months' post-registration experience and have been practising as a clinician throughout the last year, we'd love to hear from you. If you are a pharmacist, we welcome your application if you have a minimum of 18 months experience.
Flexibility and remote working:
We offer a number of flexible working arrangements that suit those who prefer to work in an Assessment Centre full time or in a hybrid role.
Working hours throughout your training are 9.00am -5.00pm Monday to Friday. Once training has been completed (typically around six months), other working patterns are available.
What you’ll be doing as a Functional Assessor:
• Carrying out functional assessments with claimants’ face to face, via video & telephone to assess their ability to undertake activities of daily living.
• Asking focused questions and use active listening and critical reasoning skills to gather accurate information throughout the claimant Assessment.
• Produce high quality, structured clinical reports on all claimants you assess, for submission to the DWP.
• Working alongside other highly experienced clinical colleagues to ensure high-quality & clinically fair assessments for all claimants.
As a Functional Assessor with Ingeus you can expect:
• Predictable hours
• Up to 10% quarterly discretionary bonus
• 25 days holiday (+BH) with the option to buy more
• Private pension
• Private medical insurance
• Maternity and Parental Leave
• Paid training, CPD + reimbursed registration fees
• Paid, structured training to achieve formal DWP accreditation
• A high performing, supportive clinically led culture
• Clear career routes within Ingeus and the wider APM Group
• Online shopping discounts
• Variety of other financial and lifestyle options
• £2000 refer a friend scheme
Whilst you will not be making decisions or recommendations as to the services and benefits for claimants, you will be using your clinical experience to ask the right questions to fully understand the claimants needs and living environment, gathering accurate information for the DWP to make those decisions.
Is this role right for you?
Many clinicians find the role of a Functional Assessor rewarding, but it’s also challenging at the same time and it’s not the right fit for everyone.
This role would suit someone who:
• Thrives on service excellence in a high performing working environment that offers structure and the opportunity to use your clinical skills in a different way.

About This Job
Are you a proactive problem solver with a passion for driving technical innovation? Do you enjoy solving complex analytical problems and delivering innovative technical solutions? Are you passionate about people development and enjoy working collaboratively? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Technical Environmental Fate Metabolism Expert with people leadership experience to join our Analytical Methods & Metabolism (AMM) team and take on the challenge of elucidating the metabolic fate of our active ingredients in the environment whilst leading a team of highly collaborative study managers and technical experts. Within the role you will also drive both technical excellence and team development whilst building strong relationships with Contract Research Organisations (CROs) to deliver critical data. Your work will directly enable the global registration of sustainable, ground-breaking crop protection technologies such as our recent breakthrough TYMIRIUM® technology which protects crops against soil-borne pests. Key responsibilities will include:
People Leadership and Strategy
• Developing talent: Leading, coaching and mentoring a collaborative team of study managers and technical experts, guiding performance and building tailored training plans.
• Fostering a dynamic culture: Instilling a highly collaborative, inclusive environment that prioritises the well-being and growth of individual team members.
• Strategic Influencing:  Contributing to the effective running and future strategic direction of the broader AMM team.
Scientific and Technical Excellence
• Holistically elucidating the environmental fate of our active ingredients: Generating key insights from environmental fate metabolism data, translating complex scientific results into expert conclusions for stakeholders.
• Driving technical solutions: Acting as a key scientific leader within the environmental fate expert area, providing critical technical assistance to internal teams and external partners to resolve diverse analytical challenges.
• Regulatory alignment:  Maintaining and building upon your expert knowledge of environmental fate metabolism and global regulatory guidance ensuring study designs meet evolving international standards.
External Collaboration and Delivery
• Resource management:  Working with internal stakeholders to manage resources to meet project timelines.
• CRO partnership: Building strong, collaborative relationships with Contract Research Organisations (CROs) to ensure the timely delivery of business critical data.

Qualifications
What we are looking for
• Degree or equivalent in a biology/chemistry or related discipline.
• Significant experience of conducting environmental fate metabolism studies for global regulatory submissions.
• Deep technical expertise of compound metabolism in the environment.
• Proven experience in people leadership, coaching and mentoring scientific staff.
• Experience of generating key insights from data sets, with the ability to present complex data clearly to multiple stakeholders.
• Ability to collaborate effectively in diverse teams, demonstrating strong organizational and analytical problem solving skills in scientific experiments.
• Active scientific participation and collaboration with colleagues in industry, contract research organisations or regulatory agencies.
• Keen attention to detail with a proactive mindset and ability to learn and apply new skills promptly in a fast-paced R&D environment.

Additional Information
Our site
Jealott's Hill International Research Centre UK is situated in pleasant semi-rural surroundings between Bracknell and Maidenhead and is the place of work for approximately 800 Syngenta scientists and support staff. Jealott’s Hill is one of the main global research and development sites and key activities include research into discovery of new active ingredients, new formulation technologies, product safety and technical support of our product range.
What we offer
• Extensive benefits package including a generous pension scheme, bonus scheme, private medical & life insurance.
• Up to 31.5 days annual holiday.
• Large campus environment.
• A position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment.
• The chance to work as part of a global team to address the current and future needs of the agricultural sector.
• Learning culture and wide range of training options.
Syngenta has been ranked as a top 5 employer and number 1 in agriculture by Science Journal.

We are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to all candidates and our Jealott’s Hill site are a Disability Confident Level 2 Employer. About This Job
Role Overview
The Senior PACS Implementation Engineer leads the build, integration, migration, and technical onboarding of customer environments onto the InSight PACS platform, acting as the technical expert for healthcare system commissioning and interoperability across NHS trusts, private healthcare providers, and third-party suppliers. The role is primarily hands-on and technical, with the successful candidate also coordinating the implementation team's day-to-day technical delivery and providing mentoring to less experienced engineers. Team leadership is a meaningful part of the role but remains secondary to its core focus on technical delivery.
Key Responsibilities
• Own end-to-end technical delivery of PACS build, integration, and migration projects, acting as the subject matter expert for DICOM, HL7, and healthcare interoperability standards across customer and partner environments.
• Design and troubleshoot integrations between PACS, RIS, EPR, VNA, and third-party clinical systems, translating customer workflows into effective, operationally sound technical solutions.
• Plan and execute imaging data migrations, including querying and troubleshooting the underlying databases, to ensure data quality and minimal disruption to clinical services.
• Lead day-to-day coordination of the implementation team's workload across build, integration, and migration activities, providing direct technical leadership, mentoring, and escalation support to engineers.
• Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Client Experience teams to improve integration capabilities, maintain technical documentation, and support pre-sales and tender activities.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications and Experience
• 5+ years of experience implementing, integrating, or migrating PACS, RIS, VNA, or other healthcare imaging solutions.
• Strong working knowledge of DICOM services (C-Store, C-Find, C-Move, Modality Worklist) and practical experience with HL7 messaging in healthcare integration contexts.
• Strong SQL and database skills, including the ability to query, interrogate, and troubleshoot databases underpinning PACS and integration platforms.
• Direct experience with PACS build, configuration, and system commissioning within a regulated healthcare environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring engineers within a technical delivery team.
Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements
• Experience working with NHS organisations, including familiarity with NHS procurement processes and digital/information governance requirements.
• Knowledge of cloud-hosted healthcare applications and services.
• Experience with imaging archive consolidation or VNA migration programmes.
• Exposure to contributing to architectural standards or reference architectures (on-premises, hybrid, or cloud-based).

Are you an experienced Station Control engineer? Do you have experience designing and implementing SCADA-systems and network solutions? Are you excited about participating in some of the largest infrastructure projects in Europe?

As our new Control Engineer, you will work on the development and implementation of control philosophies for substations and HV/MV networks. Moreover, your responsibilities will include specifying, designing and applying control and protection solutions for a wide range of complex national and international projects with a strong focus on substations and TSO interfaces. You will contribute across all project phases—from concept development and system studies to specification, design, procurement, testing, and commissioning. The role involves development of open and closed loop control strategies, development of protection philosophy and specification of the required protections and special protection schemes, design of SCADA systems including specification of hardware, protocols and interfaces.
Projects are delivered in close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams in a highly professional and continuously developing environment alongside experienced colleagues.

• Experience with implementing WAMS (Wide Area Monitoring) and WAMPAC (Wide Area Monitoring, Protection, and Control) systems

About This Job
At ALTEN, we support industry-leading organisations in the development of innovative technology solutions across a range of sectors. We are seeking a Software Test Lead to join our team and support the development of next-generation marine navigation systems.
Working on market-leading multifunction display products, you will play a key role in enhancing and evolving software features within an established product portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced test professional to lead testing activities, champion automation best practices, and drive product quality across the software development lifecycle.
Location: Portsmouth
On-site Requirement: 2 days per week onsite
Seniority: Senior
Security Clearance: Not required
Key Responsibilities & Experience
• Lead and mentor a team of test engineers, promoting best practices in software testing, automation, and quality assurance.
• Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test scripts, ensuring robust and scalable test coverage.
• Drive test planning, estimation, and testing workshops with stakeholders, supporting effective project delivery.
• Establish and maintain test automation standards, coding standards, and testing strategies across the team.
• Collaborate closely with software engineers, product teams, and stakeholders to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.
• Demonstrable experience leading testing activities and delivering commercial-grade automated test solutions within complex software environments.

Qualifications
Required Skills
• Extensive experience with Squish test automation.
• Strong Python scripting and test automation development experience.
• Proven background in test design, test execution, and test leadership.
• Experience developing and maintaining automated testing frameworks.
• Strong understanding of modern software testing methodologies, tools, and industry best practices.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and technical leadership skills.
Soft Skills & Collaboration
• Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
• Ability to influence technical direction and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
• Collaborative approach to working with cross-functional software development teams.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or relevant technical military background with equivalent experience.
Desirable Skills
• Experience with Qt frameworks.
• Knowledge of GUI testing and validation.
• Experience working on embedded software or software-controlled products.
• Familiarity with Agile development environments.
• Experience within maritime, navigation, electronics, or other safety-critical industries.

Additional Information
Why join us?
We bring together entrepreneurial, tech-driven people to deliver innovative solutions for leading companies.
At ALTEN, you’ll work on exciting projects, supported by ongoing learning, mentoring, and clear career development tailored to your goals.
Join a passionate team and help build tomorrow, today.
In short you get:
• A personalised career path and a rewarding management style
• A huge diversity of engineering projects and industries
• Private Medical Insurance
• Cycle & Tech Scheme
• Employee assistance programme
• Life insurance & Pension Scheme
• Social atmosphere, regular gatherings & team buildings
• Flexible way of working (role dependent)
We are proud to support the Armed Forces Covenant & actively encourage applications from members of the Armed Forces community, including veterans, reservists, service leavers, and military spouses/partners. We recognise the value of military skills and experience and are committed to ensuring that no applicant is unfairly disadvantaged during our recruitment and selection processes.
ALTEN is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and values the strength that comes from a global mix of backgrounds and perspectives. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of background or protected characteristics under the Equality Act 2010. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
This role may require you to have or be willing to go through Security Clearance. As part of the onboarding process candidates will be asked to complete a Baseline Personnel Security Standard; details of the evidence required to apply may be found on the government website Gov.UK. If you are unable to meet this and any associated criteria, then your employment may be delayed, or rejected . Details of this will be discussed with you at interview.

About This Job
You will play a key role in the work that directly informs Unit4's long-term strategy, collaborating with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across the organisation.
You’ll engage with both internal and external stakeholders, contribute to high-profile projects, and support decision-making at the highest level.
The right candidate is a strategic thinker who brings strong analytical rigour, a point of view, and the ability to operate independently on complex workstreams in a fast-moving environment.
Responsibilities
• Strategic Analysis & Output: Own defined analytical and research workstreams; structure findings, pressure-test logic, and translate analysis into clear recommendations and Board-ready materials; deliver with a clear point of view and limited oversight; support the preparation of other strategy and communications materials as required
• Strategic Portfolio Monitoring: Track progress against the company's strategic priorities; synthesise performance data into clear reporting for senior audiences; support the annual company-wide objective-setting process and quarterly performance reporting
• Competitive & Market Intelligence: Maintain a standing view of industry, competitive, and regulatory dynamics across Unit4's markets and develop a point of view on implications for Unit4
• Office of the CEO support: Contribute to broader Office of the CEO workstreams and priorities as required

Qualifications
• Experience: 3 - 6 years in an analytical or strategy-focused role (such as strategy consulting, corporate strategy, corporate development, investment banking or similar); candidates with technology/software experience preferred; experience in a PE-backed or adjacent environment preferred
• Excel & PowerPoint skills: Strong Excel modelling, with ability to define and execute key analyses with minimal supervision. Financial and commercial modelling capability preferred (e.g. market sizing, business case development and related analytical methods). Proficient in PowerPoint; experience building executive-level presentations and data visualisations preferred
• Analytical skills: Exceptional quantitative and analytical skills, with a proven ability to conduct financial and strategic analysis and distil findings into actionable insights for senior stakeholders
• Communication skills: Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex concepts to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner; able to present findings clearly to senior audiences
• Project management: Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
• Teamwork & collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, build stakeholder relationships and manage inputs from multiple parties
• Results orientation: Results-driven and detail-oriented, with a track record of delivering high-quality work products on time
• Adaptability: Fast learner; able to thrive in a dynamic environment, demonstrating flexibility in response to changing priorities and circumstances
• Motivation: Curious, goal-oriented, high-agency self-starter; takes initiative and drives towards outcomes
• AI fluency: Demonstrated use of AI tools to accelerate research, conduct analysis, draft documents, and sense-check outputs - with sound judgement on when and how to apply them

Additional Information
We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.
We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated.
We are reimagining how work makes people feel.
What we offer
• a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
• balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
• growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
• talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
• a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
• a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. •
Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are

About This Job
As we redefine our brand, evolve our product and accelerate global growth, we're creating a Marketing organisation that delivers inspiring, integrated campaigns capable of building brand love and driving measurable business growth.
Reporting to the VP, Global Marketing, the Head of Campaigns is responsible for bringing TuneCore's brand and marketing strategy to life through the planning, orchestration and delivery of world-class integrated campaigns.
This role sits at the heart of the Growth organisation, connecting Brand, Marketing, Product, Creative, International and Partnership teams to ensure every campaign is strategically aligned, brilliantly executed and delivers against both brand and commercial objectives. You’ll work hand in hand with our Brand and Media agencies to ensure an integrated approach and you'll establish the campaign rhythms, planning processes and cross-functional collaboration that enable the organisation to move with greater consistency, clarity and impact.
Working across brand campaigns, product launches, artist initiatives and key cultural moments, you'll ensure TuneCore speaks with one voice across every channel and every market. You'll balance global consistency with local relevance, creating scalable campaign frameworks that can be adapted to meet the needs of artists around the world.
This is an exceptional opportunity for a highly organised, commercially minded marketer who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys turning strategy into action. You're equally comfortable building detailed delivery plans, facilitating cross-functional collaboration and solving complex operational challenges, while never losing sight of the creative ambition behind the work.
You believe great campaigns don't just generate awareness - they create meaningful connections with artists, strengthen the brand and inspire action.
The tasks and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to
•
Integrated Campaign Planning
•
Develop and manage the integrated global campaign calendar across brand, product, seasonal and regional initiatives.
•
Translate marketing strategy into clear campaign plans, timelines, deliverables and success measures.
•
Ensure campaigns are prioritised, sequenced and aligned with business objectives, product roadmaps and regional market opportunities.
•
Facilitate campaign planning sessions with cross-functional stakeholders.
•
Campaign Delivery & Programme Management
•
Lead end-to-end campaign delivery from briefing through execution, optimisation and post-campaign evaluation.
•
Coordinate Brand, Creative, Growth, Product, Social, Int’l and external partners to ensure seamless execution.
•
Manage campaign timelines, dependencies, risks and stakeholder communications.
•
Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and to a consistently high standard.
•
Cross-functional Collaboration
•
Act as the central point of coordination across Growth and key business functions
•
Drive alignment across multiple workstreams, ensuring roles, responsibilities and milestones are clearly defined.
•
Build collaborative ways of working that improve communication, transparency and delivery across the organisation.
•
Campaign Operations & Process Improvement
•
Establish campaign planning frameworks, briefing templates, governance and operational best practice.
•
Continuously improve campaign workflows to increase efficiency, scalability and collaboration.
•
Support the development of marketing planning processes and operating rhythms alongside the Marketing Strategy & Operations team.
•
Embed consistent campaign management standards across the global Marketing function.
•
Campaign Performance & Optimisation
•
Partner with Growth to define campaign objectives, KPIs and measurement frameworks.
•
Monitor campaign performance throughout delivery, identifying opportunities to optimise creative, channels or execution.
•
Lead campaign retrospectives and capture learnings to improve future performance.
•
Develop regular reporting for Marketing Leadership on campaign delivery and effectiveness.
•
Global Brand & Product Launches
•
Support the planning and execution of TuneCore's major global brand campaigns, product launches and strategic initiatives.
•
Coordinate integrated launch plans across global and regional markets.
•
Ensure all campaign activity aligns with TuneCore's brand strategy, creative standards and messaging frameworks.
•
Support the successful implementation of the global rebrand across marketing initiatives and customer touchpoints.
•
Agency & Partner Management
•
Coordinate external creative, production and agency partners where required.
•
Manage campaign budgets, timelines and deliverables with external suppliers.
•
Ensure agency outputs meet agreed quality, timing and strategic objectives.

Qualifications
•
7+ years experience delivering integrated marketing campaigns within consumer technology, entertainment, media, music, creator economy or high-growth digital businesses.
•
Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional marketing programmes involving multiple stakeholders and markets.
•
Strong understanding of integrated marketing across Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, Social, Content and Creative disciplines.
•
Exceptional project and programme management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
•
Experience developing campaign plans, timelines, briefing processes and delivery frameworks.
•
Strong commercial awareness with an understanding of how campaigns contribute to brand and business performance.
•
Experience working with creative teams and agencies to deliver high-quality integrated campaigns.
•
Excellent stakeholder management, communication and facilitation skills with the ability to influence across all levels of the organisation.
•
Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to anticipate risks before they become issues.
•
Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments where processes are still being established.
•
Analytical mindset with experience interpreting campaign performance data and applying insights to future planning.
•
Experience working across international markets and coordinating global campaign delivery is highly desirable.
•
Passion for music, artists and the creator economy, with an appreciation for cultural marketing and storytelling.
Education
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
Location
This role will be based out of the New York, Believe office in Dumbo. TuneCore operates on an in-office and remote hybrid model giving our teams flexibility and choice of how they work. Required in-office Tues, Weds, Thurs.
Other duties
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/universityofthe.description_excerpt:
About This Job
About us: The University’s Health and Safety Team have an exciting opportunity for an experienced health and safety professional who is looking to further develop their career in a future-focussed University. Through our work the University has already achieved a strong devolved health and safety approach to ensure collective leadership on this critical agenda and to support staff and student engagement. As the University looks ahead to 2030 and the implementation of its Strategy 2030, there will be a focused continual improvement on health and safety. This will be achieved through the implementation of the ‘Health, Safety and Workplace Wellbeing’ Roadmap 2030’ which has eight objectives and also annually set milestones to ensure this improvement.
The development and implementation of this ambitious Roadmap is driven by the Health and Safety Team. We are a small team of health, safety and fire professionals who provide a crucial service to the University in shaping and driving its health and safety culture and ensuring that it remains a sustained strategic priority. We strive to ensure this through robust strategies and policies, strong leadership, sound governance, excellent professional advice, targeted coaching and training and reliable performance monitoring and measurement.
As a Team we take pride in ensuring a professional and courteous approach at all times, we work in partnership with our customers and seek to ensure our communication is jargon free and risk proportionate. We aim to engage and encourage ownership and above all ensure the sharing of best practice across the University to build a perpetual health and safety culture.
About you: As a Health and Safety Adviser you will play a vital role in the Health and Safety Team and will help to ensure the delivery of the Health, Safety and Wellbeing Roadmap through direct work with our University customers and partners. You will provide a proactive and professional ‘business partner’ service to one of the University’s largest professional services, Estates and Facilities.
To be successful in the role you will need to demonstrate the following experience:
·A customer-focussed, pragmatic and proactive approach to health and safety.
·The ability to work with a high level of autonomy.
·A comprehensive understanding of the risks associated with hard and soft facilities management to include construction project management, contractor management, planned maintenance, security, cleaning and catering.
·A thorough knowledge of current Health and Safety legislation, in particular construction safety and the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations.
·A detailed understanding of Health and Safety Management Systems.
·Good organisation skills, with the ability to work to tight deadlines, both prescribed and self-imposed.
·Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the demonstrable ability to produce concise written material.
This is an exciting opportunity to engage and influence at all levels and will be suited to individuals who have a real energy to drive towards a positive health and safety culture and corresponding behaviours.

We are both globally connected and regionally embedded, with strong employer and partner connections. Our staff and students come from over 160 countries making this a diverse, dynamic and rewarding place to work and study.
This post is based at our lively Frenchay campus though there will be travel required to all UWE Bristol Campuses. At the Frenchay campus we have invested in the latest facilities and resources to give both our staff and students access to everything they need to succeed – with £300m having been invested recently on new state-of-the-art learning spaces and accommodation while incredible new facilities continue to be developed to enhance our offer even further.

About This Job
Start here. Grow here.
Within our Environment & Energy (E&E) Business Lines, we are creating opportunities and delivering sustainable solutions for our clients in response to some of the world's most pressing challenges, including climate change, water scarcity and the energy transition.​
The Role:
Our Water sector is a key growth priority for Environment & Energy, presenting exciting opportunities to deliver innovative, sustainable and commercially successful solutions for our clients.
The water industry is undergoing a period of significant transformation, creating both challenges and opportunities:
• Significant change due to the Governments desire for greater public control.
• Considerable increased spending across AMP8, with the water sector competing with other sectors for resources.
• Significant opportunities for the Environmental business to support the Strategic Resource Options programme and other major programmes.
• Opportunities to extend our capability in water resources and nature-based solutions to our wider client base across Europe.
As one of our identified high growth sectors in Environment & Energy, we are seeking a Water Sector Lead to serve as the primary ambassador for Water within Environment & Energy Europe, responsible for shaping the sector’s growth strategy, building strategic client relationships, and ensuring Environment & Energy is positioned as a partner of choice in the market.
The success of this external facing role will require a combination of visible market profile and collaboration with stakeholders across the wider business. Reporting to the Environment & Energy Strategy & Growth Director for EUR&I, you will also be a member of the Environment & Energy Sales Senior Leadership Team, helping to shape our strategic direction and future growth.

• Provide strategic leadership for the sector, setting clear priorities and aligning activities to Environment & Energy Europe business objectives with a focus on UK and Ireland in 2027.

• Support Environment & Energy priorities and campaigns relevant to the sector e.g. Advisory, Infrastructure Investment, Design & Build.

The Senior AI Consultant supports clients in modernising their organisations through AI by conducting in-depth analyses of complex needs and proposing strategic solutions grounded in benchmarks, evidence, and operational reality. You formalise high-quality deliverables, evaluate the medium- and long-term impact of what you recommend, and ensure clients are satisfied with both the journey and the outcome.
This role is client-facing. In most AI engagements you will be the senior SQLI voice in the room, supported by architects and engineers from across the Data & AI service line and the wider SQLI group. You will work closely with the Service Line Manager on offer development and with solution architects on solution design.

What you will do
•
Conduct in-depth analysis of client needs and context, identify where AI delivers real value, and challenge stakeholders to develop solutions that address the actual problem rather than the surface symptom
•
Design, formalise, and propose AI solutions based on benchmarks, evidence, and feedback, with a credible path from business objective to measurable outcome
•
Advise clients on strategic and operational decision-making, assessing the medium- and long-term impact of AI adoption on their organisation, operating model, and commercials
•
Lead AI workshops, presentations, and pitches with senior client stakeholders, including non-technical audiences

Support change management around AI adoption, lead working groups, ensure skills transfer to client teams, and promote buy-in across the organisations we work with

Shape commercial proposals together with the Service Line Manager, contributing the technical and solution narrative across the full sales-to-delivery cycle
•
Work with solution architects and engineering teams to validate technical feasibility and shape solution architectures at a level you can defend in client conversations
•
Help shape new AI offers, accelerators, and reusable assets for the practice, and contribute to the internal promotion of SQLI’s AI capability
•
Ensure quality of deliverables, meet deadlines, and maintain a close advisory relationship with clients beyond individual engagements

Qualifications
Must have
•
Demonstrated experience advising enterprise clients on AI, with a portfolio of engagements you can speak to in depth
•
Strong client focus, with the ability to understand business objectives, KPIs, and operational context, and plan strategies that connect AI capabilities to measurable outcomes
•
Solid understanding of the full sales-to-delivery cycle in a consulting or agency setting
•
Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and adapt the message to the room

AI-first working style. You use AI tools (Claude in particular, also ChatGPT and others) daily to brainstorm, research, generate, and accelerate your own work, while staying in control and challenging the output when it is wrong

Practical understanding of Claude Code, Cowork, plugins and skills, MCP connectors, and what an AI agent actually is and is not

Technical background sufficient to discuss enterprise architecture, integrations, and data flows at a senior level, even if you are not the deepest technical voice in the room

Working understanding of how AI delivers value in the enterprise and where it fails, across delivery acceleration, customer-facing applications, and agentic workflows

Native-level English fluency, both spoken and written

Eligible to work in the United Kingdom

Background from an e-commerce agency, or from an AI, agentic, or workflow automation consultancy

Track record of identifying and optimising business operations and workflows using AI

Strong presentation craft, including the ability to create engaging slides, diagrams, and visual narratives

Experience contributing to or co-authoring commercial proposals, particularly outside the standard day-rate model (packaged, subscription, outcome-based)

Working French

• Collaborating with public and private stakeholders on blended finance initiatives.
• Supporting public finance strategies to unlock capital for underserved communities.
• Engaging in development finance projects mobilising resources across emerging markets.
• Mutual Mentorship and Knowledge Exchange: Fellows will receive direct mentorship from BwB’s leadership, senior ambassadors, and members of the Global Expert Group, who are recognised experts in finance, policy, and sustainability. At the same time, Fellows will be asked to provide mentorship to BwB analytical team members, drawing on their practical, market-driven experience to share expertise in areas such as: capital markets and financial structuring; sovereign and sub-sovereign debt; blended finance and impact investing; asset and risk management; and development finance institution project development and execution.
• Access to Exclusive Networking Opportunities and Events: Fellows will have opportunities to interact with members of BwB’s Global Expert Group through events such as small group sessions and roundtable discussions. Fellows will also be invited to BwB’s annual retreat – an immersive gathering designed to foster collaboration, develop new ideas, celebrate progress, and exchange experiences and insights.
• Lifelong Membership in BwB Alumni Group: Upon completing the two-year programme, Fellows transition into the BwB Alumni Group, enabling them to maintain valuable connections and draw on the collective expertise of individuals at the forefront of sustainable finance.

Qualifications
Eligibility
• Applicants must:
• Be currently working in investment banking (sell-side), asset management (buy-side), public finance, or a development finance institution.
• Have a minimum of eight years of relevant experience.
• Have a demonstrable passion for sustainability and financial innovation and a strong rationale for becoming a BwB Fellow.
• Time commitment: Up to 10 hours per month over the two-year programme, with flexibility to accommodate full-time employment.
• Compliance requirements: Formally commit to upholding BwB’s compliance standards, including adherence to NDAs, conflict of interest policies, and fit and proper requirements.
• Employer engagement: Fellows are encouraged to discuss participation with their employers to ensure alignment with internal policies.
• Financial contribution: A one-time fee of £10,000 (or equivalent in USD/EUR) is required upon acceptance to the programme.
Accessibility and Scholarship Options
At BwB, we believe that sustainable finance should be driven by a diverse and inclusive network of professionals. To ensure accessibility for individuals who may not be in a position to meet the financial commitment, a limited number of scholarship and fee-adjusted places are available. Candidates are encouraged to apply for assistance if they:
• Can demonstrate exceptional potential to contribute to driving sustainable finance.
• Have a compelling rationale for participating but face financial constraints.
Candidates should indicate their interest in a scholarship or fee adjustment during the application process by providing a brief statement outlining their situation. Scholarships will be awarded based on merit, potential impact, and commitment to BwB’s mission.

Additional Information
Participation Scope
As established above, the programme’s focus is on strategic input, high-level advisory work, and thought leadership, rather than operational execution. Fellows will provide insights and contribute to shaping BwB’s initiatives to help deliver high-impact outcomes, maintaining a hands-off position as regards direct implementation of project work.
Applications, Selection, and Intake
The BwB Fellows Programme is an unparallelled opportunity for driven individuals to help shape the future of sustainable finance and make a meaningful contribution to positive change.
Applications are accepted on a rolling basis, with Fellows joining in spring and autumn each year. The programme is highly selective, offering limited placements annually to ensure Fellows enjoy meaningful, individualised experiences.
Eligible individuals who wish to be considered for this unique programme should submit the following information to begin the candidate review process:
• A detailed statement of interest outlining their passion for sustainability.
• A record of relevant experience and achievements.

Your mission
As Senior Research Lead for Grow, you’ll own research’s strategic contribution across the entire business area. You’ll identify and initiate the research programmes that matter most, connecting questions and opportunities across multiple teams.

You’ll initially lead one or two researchers, supporting their performance, development and progression while setting clear direction for the team’s work. Success at this level means research is integral to how Grow sets direction and prioritises opportunities.
Here’s how you’ll make an impact
•
Defining research direction: Set clear direction across teams, connecting customer evidence to Grow’s product and business goals
•
Raising research quality and maturity: Set and uphold high standards, champion user-centred decision-making and improve research capability across teams
•
Strengthening research practice: Bring together people, processes, tools and standards so research is focused, efficient and consistently high quality
•
Leading through people: Develop researchers and future research leaders, cultivate a strong leadership culture and take responsibility for performance and impact
•
Using evidence to influence: Use evidence to shape core product features, multi-team roadmaps and senior stakeholder decisions
•
Building compelling narratives: Create a clear picture of the future that aligns teams and inspires Wise’s senior leaders to act
•
Managing interdependencies: Align research priorities across teams, resolve dependencies and create clarity around shared decisions
•
Using modern tools thoughtfully: Set direction for the responsible use of AI and emerging tools where they improve speed, quality or impact without weakening research rigour or judgement
About you
•
You have 10+ years’ research experience, including leading researchers across multiple teams or complex product areas
•
You have a track record of raising research quality and maturity across teams by improving craft, processes, tools and standards
•
You can shape research and product strategy across a business area and influence senior stakeholders through compelling evidence and storytelling
•
You can connect customer evidence to business outcomes and identify opportunities for research to create new value
•
You can lead diverse teams through change, complexity and ambiguity while maintaining clear direction and high standards
•
You can develop strong researchers and future leaders through clear expectations, thoughtful coaching and accountable performance management
•
You can navigate competing priorities and resolve complex people and stakeholder challenges while maintaining trust and cohesion
And as a heads up, this role probably isn't for you if:

Your experience is primarily in market research or academia, without demonstrable experience leading user research in technology or product teams
•
You want a management-only role and no longer want to plan or deliver research yourself

🚀 Join the Fusion and Modular Nuclear Business Unit! 🚀Reporting to the CAD Manager, the mechanical CAD engineer is responsible for the delivery of component models and definitions, system P&IDs, integrated layouts, and assemblies for the Small Modular Reactor (SMR). The role will involve developing an understanding of the layout and components within the SMR, collaborating with engineering designers, and generating CAD models and definitions to a high standard.

• Integrated Layout Design: Develop layout solutions from concept to construction, based on design engineer specifications.
• CAD Modeling: Create component CAD models and definitions adhering to standards.

• Data Management: Assist in product configuration and data management processes.
• Quality Assurance: Maintain quality by conducting peer reviews of models and component definitions.
• CAD Environment Management: Set up and maintain CAD tools, templates, standards, QA processes, and training materials.
• Team Support: Provide CAD expertise, training, and mentorship to the CAD/BIM team and junior staff members.
Why Join the Community of Switchers?
• 🌟 Over 55 years in nuclear engineering.
• 🏆 Ranked among the top 3 largest nuclear engineering companies.
• 💼 Attractive social benefits, including an engaging Employee Committee and holiday bonuses.
• 📚 Ongoing training with numerous career opportunities.
• 📈 70% of our managers are promoted internally!
• 🏠 Hybrid work: 1-2 days remote per week.

Qualifications
• Experienced Mechanical CAD Engineer or similar role, ready to drive innovation and excellence.
• Collaborative team player with a knack for transforming concepts into reality through engineering teamwork.
• Proficient in 2D CAD systems like AutoCAD for creating precise and detailed drawings.
• Skilled in 3D CAD/BIM systems (Revit, Inventor, Solidworks, Solid Edge, Siemens NX, PDMS, AutoCAD Plant 3D, or similar) for crafting dynamic models and drawings.
• Professionally qualified in an engineering-related field, bringing expertise and technical prowess.
• SC Clearance or the capability to achieve it, ensuring readiness for high-security projects.

Due to the nature of the work, applicants must meet UK security clearance criteria.

About This Job
• Starting Salary £49,432
• Full time Monday - Friday 9.00am - 5.00pm
• Opportunity to achieve a £2k salary uplift over the first 12 months, based on achievement of development milestones.
• Further salary uplifts as you learn new specialist skills from year 2.
• Up to 10% quarterly discretionary bonus
• 25 days holiday (+BH) with the option to buy more
Are you looking to your clinical skills in a different way? As a Functional Assessor, you'll continue to utilise your clinical expertise, maintain your registration, and enjoy a better work-life balance. If you have a minimum of 12 months' post-registration experience and have been practising as a clinician throughout the last year, we'd love to hear from you. If you are a pharmacist, we welcome your application if you have a minimum of 18 months experience.
Flexibility and remote working:
We offer a number of flexible working arrangements that suit those who prefer to work in an Assessment Centre full time or in a hybrid role.
Working hours throughout your training are 9.00am -5.00pm Monday to Friday. Once training has been completed (typically around six months), other working patterns are available.
What you’ll be doing as a Functional Assessor:
• Carrying out functional assessments with claimants’ face to face, via video & telephone to assess their ability to undertake activities of daily living.
• Asking focused questions and use active listening and critical reasoning skills to gather accurate information throughout the claimant Assessment.
• Produce high quality, structured clinical reports on all claimants you assess, for submission to the DWP.
• Working alongside other highly experienced clinical colleagues to ensure high-quality & clinically fair assessments for all claimants.
As a Functional Assessor with Ingeus you can expect:
• Predictable hours
• Up to 10% quarterly discretionary bonus
• 25 days holiday (+BH) with the option to buy more
• Private pension
• Private medical insurance
• Maternity and Parental Leave
• Paid training, CPD + reimbursed registration fees
• Paid, structured training to achieve formal DWP accreditation
• A high performing, supportive clinically led culture
• Clear career routes within Ingeus and the wider APM Group
• Online shopping discounts
• Variety of other financial and lifestyle options
• £2000 refer a friend scheme
Whilst you will not be making decisions or recommendations as to the services and benefits for claimants, you will be using your clinical experience to ask the right questions to fully understand the claimants needs and living environment, gathering accurate information for the DWP to make those decisions.
Is this role right for you?
Many clinicians find the role of a Functional Assessor rewarding, but it’s also challenging at the same time and it’s not the right fit for everyone.
This role would suit someone who:
• Thrives on service excellence in a high performing working environment that offers structure and the opportunity to use your clinical skills in a different way.
• Is open to a formalised programme of training to become a DWP approved Functional Assessor.
• Is receptive to ongoing constructive feedback, ensuring our claimants continually get the very best experience.
• Has confidence in their ability to use computers and in learning different software packages to complete detailed, high-quality reports for all claimants assessed.
This role may not be the best match for you if:
• You are not comfortable using or are unfamiliar with technology.
• You dislike writing detailed reports.
• You prefer a more hands on approach to clinical care.
• You’re not looking for a new direction nor a period of retraining into a new role.
• You don’t enjoy working in an environment with targets.
• You are not looking for a role that requires you to work on site for some or all of your working week.3 days a week.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Qualifications
Who We’re Looking For
• NMC-registered Adult Nurses (RGN, RMN, RNLD) or HCPC-registered Physiotherapists, Occupational Therapists and Paramedics or GPHC-registered Pharmacists.
With excellent communication & critical-thinking skills, the ability to type and confidence using computers

Additional Information
At Ingeus, our culture is built on treating everyone with dignity, ensuring every individual feels valued, respected and recognised for their contribution.
As a Disability Confident Employer, we understand that everyone’s journey is different, and we’re committed to making our recruitment process as inclusive and accessible as possible. If you require any support or adjustments—whether that’s help with the application, interview format, or anything else—we’re here to listen and work with you to find the best approach. Our goal is to ensure you can showcase your skills and potential in a way that works for you. Please don’t hesitate to contact us to discuss how we can support you.
Please note, we may shortlist and conduct interviews before the closing date and we may close this role early if we receive enough applications.

About This Job
Join our program supporting Airbnb’s Luxe program as a Home Consultant and help us uphold the exceptional quality and hospitality standards expected from the luxury homes in Airbnb’s Luxe offering.
As part of our Managed Services program, you will conduct in-person home assessments, document property conditions, capture photos, and provide detailed evaluation reports to support our luxury quality review process. Consultants typically complete home consultations in approximately 2 hours, with some variation depending on property size.
*Please note that this project operates on an as needed basis. Assignment volume may fluctuate throughout the duration of the program and is not guaranteed. Some weeks may have higher activity levels while others may be lighter depending on operational demand and market needs.
What you'll do:
• Conduct in-person onsite home consultations and property evaluations
• Capture high-quality photos and document property conditions
• Complete structured assessment reports based on your independent expert evaluation of the properties using provided guidelines and templates
• Maintain professional and responsive communication and interactions with Hosts
• Coordinate scheduling and availability through MediaBox and email communication
• Ensure timely and accurate submission of reports following each consultation

Qualifications
Who you are:
• Preferred but not required: background in hospitality, customer service, interior design, real estate, or related fields
• Flexible schedule
• You have reliable transportation and a willingness to travel to assigned locations
• You own a phone or tablet that can be used to complete reports and upload photos
• Amazing communication skills
• Strong attention to details
• Proficient in written and spoken English
• Tech-comfortable and able to complete reports via a stable internet connection
• You are located within 1 hour driving distance from the job post location you are applying for

Additional Information
Compensation Structure
This opportunity offers compensation on a per-assignment basis. Candidates should propose their rate for reviewing and submitting a report for a 1-bedroom home.  Average base rates within this region generally fall between $85 - $105 for a 1-bedroom property.  An additional $5 USD will be added for each additional bedroom, up to 8 bedrooms total.
Base Compensation
Example:
• 1 bedroom = your proposed base rate
• 2 bedrooms = base rate + $5
• 3 bedrooms = base rate + $10
• Etc. up to 8 bedrooms (all house sizes above 8 bedrooms will receive the 8 bedroom rate)
Travel Compensation
In addition to the consultation fee, consultants will also receive  compensation for travel for each day they conduct an assessment at a predetermined rate based on the consultant's distance from the center of the zone they are assigned to.  Travel compensation will range from $5 - $92 depending on the zone and the candidate’s proximity to the assigned zone.
Additional information about the travel compensation and related requirements and procedures will be shared with candidates before offers are extended.

Your role will involve designing, calculating and proposing fire safety solutions on small and large projects while acting as a key point of contact. You will also undertake surveys, produce reports, and support day‑to‑day project management for secured programmes.

About This Job
About the Role
The UK water sector is entering a period of unprecedented investment and transformation. As Egis accelerates the growth of its Water Business in the UK, we are building a high-performing Process Engineering team to help shape this next chapter.
We are inviting applicants who want to play a meaningful role in delivering major water and wastewater programmes in the UK municipal and industrial sectors. Working within a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment, you will contribute to technically robust, sustainable and innovative treatment solutions across nationally significant projects.
This is a rare opportunity to join at a key stage of our UK growth journey, helping to establish, shape and expand a process engineering capability built on Egis’ global infrastructure expertise and long-term commitment to the sector.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead process design delivery on multidisciplinary water/wastewater treatment projects across the full design lifecycle.
• Act as process technical lead on projects, owning design strategy, treatment process selection, key decisions, interfaces, risks and quality of deliverables.
• Review and approve process calculations, mass balances, PFDs, P&IDs, basis of design reports, specifications, technical notes, models and supplier/contractor submissions.
• Lead process modelling and simulation activities using tools such as BioWin, SUMO, Dynamizu or equivalent packages.
• Lead optioneering, process capacity assessments, value engineering, design reviews, HAZOP/SWIFT, commissioning strategy and performance testing input.
• Drive multidisciplinary coordination across Mechanical, EICA, civil/structural, architectural, MEP, construction, commissioning and operations teams.
• Promote lean and digitally enabled delivery through standardised tools, process models, automation, data analysis and reusable templates.
• Provide technical assurance and support project managers with technical risk, scope, resourcing, programme and change control.
• Mentor and manage engineers where appropriate, supporting recruitment, development and chartership progression.
• Contribute to bids, client engagement, opportunity shaping and growth of the process capability.

Qualifications
Minimum Requirements
• BEng/MEng or equivalent in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering or closely related discipline.
• Chartered Engineer or Incorporated Engineer status with a relevant professional institution, such as IChemE.
• Typically 8–10+ years’ relevant process design experience.
• Background must be from water, wastewater and/or biosolids/sludge treatment design.
• Proven ability to act as process discipline lead or senior technical lead on multidisciplinary projects.
• Strong technical expertise in water/wastewater treatment process design, including process selection, mass balance, process capacity, PFDs, P&IDs and design basis development.
• Practical experience using process modelling/simulation packages such as BioWin, SUMO, Dynamizu or equivalent.
• Strong understanding of UK water industry standards, CDM 2015, process safety, safety-by-design, regulatory drivers and common delivery models.
• Confident client-facing communicator with experience leading workshops, technical reviews and design discussions.
• Experience mentoring or managing engineers and supporting technical capability development.
Desirable Skills / Knowledge
• Deep experience in wastewater treatment, clean water treatment, sludge/bioresources, nutrient removal, water reuse/recycling, process optimisation, chemical dosing, energy recovery or low-carbon design.
• Experience delivering AMP8, WINEP, SRO, D&B, framework, alliance or contractor-led projects.
• Advanced capability in BioWin, SUMO, Dynamizu, process model calibration, scenario testing, dynamic simulation or operational optimisation.
• Experience developing process design standards, calculation tools, modelling workflows, QA processes or reusable digital templates.
• Experience contributing to recruitment, resource planning, bid writing, technical proposals, client presentations or new service development.
Please note that you must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this position.

• Hybrid and flexible working
• 26+ days annual leave plus bank holidays
• Professional development, chartership support & global mobility
• Supportive, inclusive culture driven by sustainability and long‑term community impact
Ready to Lead?

We are committed to our planet
In each project we design, engineer and operate we care deeply about the legacy we’re leaving behind. As part of our team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to use your skills and expertise to shape a better future for our communities in the UK, and all around the globe.

About This Job
ThinCats is the Group's specialist brand for mid sized SMEs, providing consistent, timely and flexible funding solutions of £2m to £30m through pioneering data, personal relationships and a pragmatic lending process. This role sits within Corporate Leverage and is originated under the ThinCats brand.
• Independent Sponsors (“IS”) are experienced dealmakers who identify, structure and lead buyouts and growth acquisitions without a committed fund behind them, raising equity deal by deal from co-investment partners as each transaction requires. Sponsors typically secure exclusivity first and syndicate equity to close, so judging equity certainty and the sponsor's ability to deliver it is central to the underwrite.
• As Senior Director, you will be a senior originator and a recognised part of ThinCats' face to market in the independent sponsor community, driving the identification, structuring and execution of IS transactions, and leading deal teams including more junior colleagues.
• You will own the client and sponsor relationship on your transactions, working within the appetite, pricing framework and standards set by the Head of Independent Sponsors, and contributing to the team's origination, profitability and return on equity targets.
Key Responsibilities
Originate With Authority
• Maintain an active network of senior level relationships with independent sponsors, their co-investment partners, intermediaries and advisers active in the UK lower mid-market.
• Act as a key “go-to” point of contact for inbound enquiries and be recognised as part of ThinCats' face to market in the independent sponsor community, generating new opportunities through targeted outbound activity.
• Qualify opportunities against IS criteria and the team's risk appetite, focusing on majority or control positions, or significant minority stakes with clearly controlling governance rights, and recognising when a transaction is better served elsewhere in the Group.
Structure and Deliver
• Structure, negotiate and execute the larger and more complex IS debt facilities, underwriting the target business, the sponsor's track record and their ability to deliver equity certainty to completion.
• Analyse target businesses and financial models in detail to build a thorough view of risk, and structure facilities that meet the sponsor's needs while protecting the Bank appropriately.
• Write or supervise high quality sighting and credit papers, ensuring all material risks are identified, minimised and mitigated, and presented with a clear recommendation.
• Lead the client and sponsor relationship through diligence, credit approval and legal completion, working with the Transaction Management team who drive execution, and keeping the deal moving through clear direction and fast decisions.
Lead and Develop
• Lead deal teams, including more junior colleagues, on your own transactions and in support of colleagues' deals more broadly.
• Maintain senior level relationships with Portfolio, Risk, Operations, Credit and Finance relevant to any given transaction.
• Serve as a role model within the team, supporting the development of less experienced team members.
Act With Judgement on Risk, Governance and Conduct
• Report all issues of regulatory concern to the Operations Director / Bank Legal & Compliance Director promptly and effectively.
• Maintain strong governance and conduct discipline throughout: clear rationale, strong documentation, no surprises.

Qualifications
Skills & Experience
• Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to manage complex issues; strong grounding in financial models and financial statements.
• In-depth knowledge of leveraged and acquisition finance structures, including negotiation of legal documentation.
• Judgement on equity certainty and syndication risk in deal-by-deal funded transactions.
• Strong track record of commercial acumen, strategic thinking, executive level reporting and effective business planning.
• Thorough comprehension of credit risk management, credit administration, loan production and servicing.
Education/Professional Qualifications
Shawbrook is committed to providing opportunities to all candidates, and understand that not all candidates may possess a qualification or education aligned to the role. We will assess each candidate on their individual experience and skills, and not solely on level of education.
Key attributes
• An originator first: established in the independent sponsor market and hungry to build ThinCats' franchise there.
• Comfortable underwriting without a fund behind the sponsor: assesses the sponsor's track record, co-investor base and ability to close as rigorously as the underlying business.
• Disciplined about scope: qualifies hard against IS criteria and knows when a transaction is better served elsewhere.
• Preferably 10 years' experience in financial services, including 5 years' experience leading senior corporate leverage or independent sponsor cashflow debt transactions.

Additional Information
Your Wellbeing - We take your health and well-being very seriously by providing a range of benefits to give you and your family peace of mind. These include:
• Market leading family friendly policies such as access to our Maternity, Adoption and Paternity policies from Day 1 of your employment
• Free access to Headspace, a mindfulness & meditation digital health app
• Free access to Peppy digital health app that offers personalised support through fertility treatment becoming a parent or menopause
• EAP (Employee Assistance Programme) - Offering you support on a wide range of subjects including financial concerns, mental wellbeing and more general queries around family, work, housing, and health

• Discounts on gym membership

Your Lifestyle - It’s important you strike the right balance between your work and personal life. We provide benefits to support you when at work and when you’re enjoying your leisure time.

About This Job
Job Title: Clinical Standards Lead
Salary: £48,235.20
Location: Remote
What you’ll be doing
The Clinical Standards Lead role will work closely with new and experienced Functional Assessors to provide supervision and feedback, utilising quality and productivity data to enable professional development in line with the Performance Excellence Framework.
The successful applicant will also need to maintain their DWP approval by carrying out assessments to evaluate the overall functional effects of the Claimant’s health condition and or disability on their everyday life, following WCA guidelines. Assessors will be expected to use DWP processes and systems and conduct high quality assessments in an empathetic and professional manner.

• Carry out regular 1:1 supervision, clinical observations, and dip tests/ live dip tests (audits), coaching HPs in line with defined Support Pathways based on quality performance related risk assessments.
