• Supervise the support pathways of Functional Assessors as defined within the Performance Excellence Framework, utilising clinical audit and quality outcomes with a view to achieving sustained quality improvement within the contract.
• Carry out telephone, video and/ or face-to-face functional assessments to establish any functional restriction caused by a claimant’s health concern. Be the point of contact during the consultation stage for claimants with a wide range of health conditions and disabilities.
• Obtain evidence from the claimant, using active listening and asking appropriate questions to establish any functional restriction.
• Apply critical thinking and logical reasoning to produce accurate, and detailed reports, utilising DWP systems and processes.
• Ensure that reports are completed to a high standard to achieve the required quality grades, including in relation to accurate spelling and grammar.
• Support achievement of service delivery KPIs through provision of an effective and efficient Assessment Service.
• Liaise with a range of clinical peers across the NHS and private healthcare sector, charities, and support organisations to obtain and evaluate evidence that assists in the production of detailed reports.
• Proactively develop knowledge of health conditions through engaging with Continuous Professional Development (CPD) opportunities in line with professional registration and contractual requirements.
• Undertake any training required to carry out Functional Assessor role e.g., Paper-based Reviews and initial Triage.
• Take ownership of professional revalidation to ensure that this is completed within the required timescales.

Qualifications

• A minimum of 12 months experience as a DWP approved Functional Assessor, achieving consistently high-quality clinical audit outcomes.
• Be HCPC / NMC/ GMC registered with no restrictions on practice.
• Have a proven record of proactively engaging with relevant Continual Professional Development (CPD).
• Broad-ranging clinical experience across a range on conditions, including working with adults.
• Demonstrable knowledge of the clinical aspects and likely functional effects of a wide range of medical conditions, including skills in assessing people and the ability to perform a relevant examination.
• Knowledge and skills in assessing people with conditions affecting mental health, intellectual and cognitive function including the ability to perform a relevant examination.
• Ability to critically evaluate evidence and use logical reasoning to provide accurate evidence-based advice.
• Have excellent interpersonal and written communication skills that include the ability to interact sensitively and appropriately, take a comprehensive, history; accurately recording clinical findings, producing succinct, accurate reports in Plain English, while utilising a questioning style that allows the Claimant to talk freely about their level of function.
• Be able to take part in the continuous feedback cycle, including 360-degree feedback, and use this feedback to improve practice.
• Efficient IT skills and an ability to type notes accurately whilst conducting assessments (30 words per minute minimum).
• Ability to maintain a strong work ethic while working independently.
• Ability and willingness to share clinical experience and knowledge to positive effect within a team.
• Comfortable working to team and individual targets.
• An eye for detail.
• Driven and flexible.
• Demonstrable ability to manage time effectively.

The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading much of the Public Health and Fire Protection systems design on projects and involve client liaison, mentoring and leading the discipline/systems to prepare scheme and detailed engineering designs. The successful candidate will have proven design experience, delivering to quality, time and budget. This role will suit someone with who is enthusiastic, self-motivated, and looking to advance their career.
The role will include taking point lead on multiple PH systems design/calculations on a project as well as assisting the lead PH engineer with experience in the following systems:

• Water and oil leak detection systems

Duties of the role will include, but not be limited to;

• Obtain the necessary information both internally and externally from Architects, Quantity Surveyors and Design Consultants to provide a fully coordinated design
• Ensure the Design Team is kept fully informed of all technical and other information necessary for the duration of the project
• Be familiar with the BIM design process and be capable of input and support for projects designed in Revit
• Ensure compliance with all Statutory and Regulatory obligations, make submissions to the Statutory Authorities and obtain approvals as necessary
• Produce all design information and ensure that all calculations are prepared and signed off in accordance with the requirements of the QA procedures, relevant Standards and Codes of Practice
• Represent AECOM at Client, Design Team and Progress meetings throughout the design and construction phases of projects
• Support AECOM PM with input to pre-qualification and selection of contractors, also respond to tender queries, comment and review tender returns

Minimum Requirements:

The CTO Office is an independent unit within Product & Customer with a dual mandate: track what is genuinely happening at the frontier of the industry, and convert it into technology strategy and working software inside IFS. Data foundations: pipelines and lakehouse patterns (Microsoft Fabric/OneLake, Databricks, or equivalents), streaming and event-driven integration where the problem demands it

Classical ML depth alongside GenAI: forecasting, anomaly detection, predicThe role
•
This is a hands-on architect role that grows into a player-coach role. You will start as the senior technical individual contributor in the CTO Office and then hire and lead a small team of engineers built in your image.
•
The unit takes on whatever matters most at the time. One month that is a production-grade agentic system with a frontier model provider, the next it is an architecture review of a platform under consideration, an internal AI tool the whole company adopts, or a technical escalation from a strategic customer. There is no standing backlog to hide behind. You go in, learn the domain fast, deliver something real in weeks, and hand it over or harden it.
•
We are explicit about the calibre we are hiring for. The team exists to produce output that would normally take a squad a quarter, in a fraction of the time, at production quality. If that sounds exhausting rather than energising, this is the wrong role.
What you will do
•
Own architecture and delivery on the CTO Office's highest-priority technical projects, end to end
•
Write and review code daily; the role never becomes slideware
•
Design and ship agentic and LLM-based systems to production standard: retrieval at scale, evals, guardrails, security and identity, monitoring and auditability
•
Drop into unfamiliar codebases, stacks, and business domains and become dangerous within days
•
Hire, coach, and set the technical bar for a small team of applied AI engineers
•
Brief executives and senior customer stakeholders on what you built and what it means commercially

Qualifications
What we are looking for
•
15+ years building software, with architecture ownership of systems running in production at enterprise scale
•
Still keyboard-credible: you review PRs, debug agents, and ship. We will verify this in the interview process
•
Deep, current applied AI capability: production agentic systems, RAG and Graph RAG, MCP, agent runtimes, and fluency across model providers rather than loyalty to one
•
Eval fluency. You can articulate and build an evaluation strategy for an LLM system. Candidates who cannot are not a fit, regardless of seniority

Evidence of operating AI systems at enterprise scale, not a portfolio of PoCs

Range and speed: a track record of delivering across different domains, stacks, and problem shapes under time pressure

Experience hiring engineers and raising a team's technical standard
•
Clear written and spoken communication at executive level
Technical depth expected
•
We hire for depth per area, not a keyword count. The named tools are examples; strong equivalents are fine. Expect to be tested on the areas below, not asked whether you have heard of them.

Languages: expert-level Python and TypeScript for AI and product work, and the ability to read and contribute to the large enterprise codebases you will drop into (C#/.NET, Java)

Model providers: hands-on production work with at least 2 of Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and open-weight models (direct APIs or via Azure AI Foundry, Bedrock, Vertex); tool use and function calling, structured outputs, context and token management, prompt architecture

Agentic systems: designing, hosting, and operating autonomous and semi-autonomous agents in production; MCP servers and clients; orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Pydantic AI, or provider-native SDKs; sandboxing, permissioning, and human-in-the-loop design
•
Retrieval and knowledge: RAG and Graph RAG at enterprise scale; vector and hybrid search (pgvector, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, or dedicated stores) including chunking strategy, reranking, and distributed retrieval; knowledge graphs and entity resolution; Text-to-SQL over complex enterprise schemas
•
Evals and quality: golden datasets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge patterns, online monitoring of model behaviour; tooling such as RAGAS, promptfoo, Langfuse or LangSmith, or eval harnesses you built yourself
•
Security, identity, and governance: OAuth2/OIDC, Entra ID and service principals, secrets management; guardrails and content safety; auditability and traceability of agent decisions
•
Cloud and platform: production Kubernetes and containerisation, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), CI/CD; deep in at least 1 hyperscaler (Azure preferred given our estate) with working literacy in the others
•
Observability and operations: OpenTelemetry or equivalent distributed tracing applied to LLM systems, cost and latency engineering, capacity planning for tive maintenance
•
Industrial, asset-intensive, or enterprise software domain exposure (EAM, ERP, FSM)
•
Working knowledge of AI governance frameworks such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF
•
Prior 0-to-1 work: standing up a capability, product, or team from nothing
How we assess
A walkthrough of systems you have personally architected and shipped, a technical deep dive including your eval and production-hardening approach, and a working session on a live problem. References will be asked specifically about hands-on contribution, not leadership style.
Practicalities
•
Location and working model: Virtual/Hybrid – location dependent
•
Compensation: Upon discussion

Some international travel

About This Job
At Legal & General, we’re helping workplace scheme members better understand their savings, benefits and financial wellbeing. This role is all about taking information that can feel complex and turning it into clear, engaging and practical presentations that help people make more informed decisions.
We’re looking for Client Presentation Managers to join our Workplace Savings team. You’ll be creating and delivering member-facing webinars, presentations and benefit fair materials, working closely with clients, client directors and internal teams to make sure every session is well planned, easy to understand and delivered with confidence.
This role will involve regular UK travel for in-person presentations and client/member events, likely around once a week on average.
What you'll be doing:
• Creating clear and engaging presentation materials for workplace scheme members
• Delivering webinars, benefit fairs and employee engagement presentations
• Speaking with clients and client directors to understand requirements and agree content needs
• Coordinating webinar planning, logistics, content preparation and follow-up activity
• Managing timelines, stakeholder updates and delivery expectations across multiple sessions
• Turning pensions and financial wellbeing information into simple, member-friendly content
• Working with Customer Engagement, content, copy and creative teams to produce high-quality materials
• Ensuring all materials follow brand guidelines, Consumer Duty principles and tone of voice expectations
Who we're looking for:
• Experience presenting to a range of audiences, ideally through webinars, events or client/member-facing sessions
• Strong PowerPoint and presentation-building skills, with the ability to create clear and visually engaging decks
• Confidence working with clients, senior stakeholders or internal partners to understand needs and manage expectations
• Strong organisation skills, with experience managing timelines, logistics and multiple deliverables
• Ability to explain complex information in a simple, practical and audience-friendly way
• Familiarity with pensions, financial wellbeing or workplace savings would be helpful
• Experience in financial services, professional services, employee benefits or a similar client-facing environment would be beneficial
• Willingness to travel across the UK for face-to-face member and client activity
• UK driving license
Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:
• The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
• Generous pension contribution
• Life assurance
• Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
• At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
• Competitive family leave
• Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
• There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
• We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience

Additional Information
At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.
If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.
We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.
It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

About This Job
ABOUT US
We are looking for an experienced and visionary Senior Product Lead – Casino & Innovation to join our Playradar (iGaming) division based in our Vienna, London, Ljubljana or Munich office.
Reporting directly to the VP Product, you will own the strategic direction of our entire casino and interactive gaming portfolio, defining what Playradar builds next and ensuring every product delivers an outstanding player experience and commercial value.
This is a highly influential leadership role for an experienced product professional who combines exceptional product intuition with strong commercial thinking, deep gaming expertise, and a passion for innovation. You will shape our long-term product vision, identify new market opportunities, drive product innovation, and set the quality bar across our portfolio.
Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, Sports Rights Holders and executive leadership, you will take end-to-end ownership of the product lifecycle from identifying opportunities and validating concepts through gameplay definition, product quality, launch readiness and continuous optimization.
Playradar operates like a fast-growing start-up within Sportradar, combining the agility of an entrepreneurial environment with the scale and reach of a global technology company. This role offers the opportunity to significantly influence the future of our portfolio and become one of the key drivers of Playradar's long-term success.
THE CHALLENGE
Product Vision & Portfolio Strategy
• Define and drive the long-term product vision and strategy for Playradar's casino and interactive gaming portfolio.
• Own portfolio evolution by identifying new product categories, gameplay concepts, mechanics and market opportunities.
• Decide which product opportunities move into development based on customer value, commercial potential and strategic fit.
• Continuously evaluate market trends, player behaviour, emerging technologies and competitor offerings to shape future product direction and innovative game ideas.
• Partner with executive leadership to define strategic priorities and investment decisions.
• Ensure a balanced portfolio that maximizes innovation, differentiation and long-term commercial success.
Product Discovery & Innovation
• Lead product discovery through market research, player insights, competitive analysis and data-driven decision making.
• Drive innovation initiatives across the portfolio, leveraging emerging technologies, AI capabilities and rapid prototyping methodologies.

• Validate concepts early through prototypes, customer feedback and market evaluation before committing development resources.
• Build compelling product concepts, business cases and strategic recommendations for executive decision-making.
Product Leadership & Execution
• Take end-to-end ownership of products from initial concept through launch and continuous lifecycle management.
• Define gameplay, product features, user experience and product requirements together with Product, Design and Engineering teams.
• Drive product decisions throughout development and ensure alignment across all stakeholders.
• Own product readiness by ensuring every release meets Playradar's quality standards before reaching customers.
• Partner closely with the Design Lead to ensure gameplay, UX, visual execution and overall player experience meet the highest quality expectations.
• Challenge priorities, assumptions and proposed solutions to maximize product quality and business impact.
• Facilitate product reviews and final product approvals prior to release.
Product Performance & Portfolio Success
• Define and own product success metrics across the portfolio.
• Use player behaviour, product analytics and commercial insights to continuously optimize products after launch.
• Monitor KPIs including player engagement, retention, monetization, revenue contribution, ROI and overall portfolio performance.
• Drive product lifecycle decisions, including feature evolution, optimization, scaling and retirement.
• Ensure every product contributes to the long-term growth and commercial success of the Playradar portfolio.
Cross-Functional Leadership
• Build trusted partnerships across Product, Design, Engineering, Commercial, Operations and executive leadership.
• Provide strategic product leadership across multiple teams and initiatives.
• Drive alignment between business objectives, customer needs and technical execution.
• Collaborate closely with Sports Rights Holders and external partners to identify new product opportunities.
• Support and mentor Product Managers while fostering a strong product culture focused on customer value, innovation and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous evolution of Playradar's product management practices and operating model.
ABOUT YOU
• 8+ years of Product Management experience, including significant leadership experience within the Gaming, Casino Games or Interactive Entertainment industry.
• Proven track record of defining and delivering commercially successful gaming products and product portfolios.
• Deep understanding of player behaviour, game mechanics, monetization models, retention strategies and product lifecycle management.
• Strong product vision with the ability to identify future trends and translate them into successful product strategies.
• Demonstrated experience leading product discovery, innovation and concept development.
• Strong commercial mindset with the ability to balance customer value, product quality and business performance.
• Outstanding strategic thinking and analytical capabilities with a data-driven approach to product decision-making.
• Experience defining product KPIs and optimizing products through player insights, analytics and experimentation.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the confidence to influence senior leadership and challenge assumptions constructively.
• Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments.
• Passion for building exceptional player experiences and maintaining an uncompromising quality bar across a product portfolio.
NICE TO HAVE
• Experience leading multiple product teams or mentoring senior Product Managers.
• Established network and strong market knowledge within the global gaming industry.
• Experience working with Sports Rights Holders or sports-related products.
• Experience with AI-powered product development, rapid prototyping and innovation frameworks.
• Experience working in high-growth, entrepreneurial or scale-up environments.
• Familiarity with modern product operating models and portfolio management practices.

About This Job
Start here. Grow here
Aviation is one of the key focus sectors at AECOM, a business sector which sits within our number one rated global transportation engineering consultancy. Whilst we are already the number one aviation engineering consultancy by revenue globally, we see significant future growth potential as the sector recovers from the downturn induced by the Covid 19 outbreak. Our clients are now re-investing in their assets, to ensure they are in the right condition, but also to ensure their capacity needs of the future.
AECOM is actively seeking a Graduate Aviation Engineer to support a wide range of aviation-related pavement and civil infrastructure projects for airport clients. In this role, you will assist with the design, planning, and construction support of airport engineering projects, including runways, taxiways, aprons, aircraft stands, boarding bridges, vehicle service roads, airfield lighting and signage, navigational aids, surface water drainage systems, utilities, and airfield asset inspection and rehabilitation. You’ll work on projects of varying scale and complexity, gaining valuable hands-on experience across all stages of project delivery.
As a Graduate Aviation Civil Engineer, candidates will be involved in:
• Aviation Masterplanning
• Feasibility and Assessment studies
• Concept and Detailed Design development
• Construction Support
• Airport asset inspections
• Airport pavement design
• Airport civil infrastructure design (utilities, surface water etc)
• Geometrical airport planning
• Apron Stand / Air Bridge planning
• Aeronautical Ground Lighting and Signage design
• Aircraft stand modelling and tracking
• Modelling of the airport environment in 3D
Early work with us will typically be assisting in developing our projects through the different stages, from initial feasibility through to detailed design, attending meetings and workshops with other design professionals. As you develop, you will be provided with opportunity to take on greater responsibility in supporting the management and delivery of projects from inception through to completion.

Qualifications
• BEng in Civil Engineering or Engineering Science 2:1 (or equivalent)
• MEng in Civil Engineering or Engineering Science 2:1 (or equivalent) would be an advantage and / or MSc in Aviation Planning
• Enthusiastic, hard-working, with ambition and drive
• Good report writing skills beneficial
• A strong understanding of IT skills required and experience with AutoCAD beneficial
• Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing
• Ability to structure & prioritise work effectively through close cooperation with the team as a whole
• Ability to work in a team and independently without losing initiative & focus.

Additional Information
• Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected for an advanced offer start.
• Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades.
• You must have permanent right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM
AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.
Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.
We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com  if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

Our Water sector is a key growth priority for Environment & Energy, presenting exciting opportunities to deliver innovative, sustainable and commercially successful solutions for our clients.
The water industry is undergoing a period of significant transformation, creating both challenges and opportunities:
• Significant change due to the Governments desire for greater public control.

About This Job
The Senior Product Manager, Payments will cover a maternity leave for a period of 12 months, stepping into ownership of specific payments product streams and maintaining continuity and momentum on initiatives already in flight. You'll work as an individual contributor, owning your product areas end-to-end and managing two squads.
Payments sits at the centre of how Shawbrook moves money for savers and borrowers alike, from deposit funding flows through to supplier and third-party payment processing arrangements. This role decides how those product areas evolve day to day, while the permanent postholder is away.
Key Responsibilities
Payments Product Ownership
• Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for one or more payments product streams, from discovery and ideation through to delivery, launch, and post-launch iteration.
• Represent your product area's requirements through any in-flight initiatives, ensuring no loss of pace or institutional knowledge during the handover period.
• Maintain a clear, prioritised backlog for your product streams, working closely with Engineering to translate business and customer needs into deliverable requirements.
Roadmap & Prioritisation
• Maintain and deliver the agreed roadmap for your product areas, gathering and summarising demand from business stakeholders.
• Partner with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Compliance, Finance, Commercial) to prioritise initiatives that deliver ROI, reduce risk exposure, and align with the bank's strategic goals.
• Maintain a data-led view of product and customer/colleague impact, grounding prioritisation in evidence rather than stakeholder volume.
Supplier & Regulatory Management
• Manage relationships with payment suppliers, scheme partners, and processors, including input into contract terms and pricing agreements.
• Ensure product decisions are made in line with legal and regulatory requirements relevant to UK payments and financial services.
Business Case & Value Realisation
• Build and support business cases for payments product investment, using real, in-flight examples as reference points.
• Ensure your initiatives have robust business cases and stakeholder buy-in to move swiftly into delivery.
Cross-functional Collaboration
• Act as the day-to-day link between Engineering, Compliance, Commercial, and Customer Success on your product streams.
• Escalate roadmap conflicts or resourcing trade-offs to the Product Lead where consensus isn't possible.
• Bring a mindset of continuous discovery and structured prioritisation to your product areas.
Value This Role Will Add
• Provides continuity of ownership for payments product streams during the maternity leave period, with no gap in delivery or stakeholder relationships.
• Owns business outcomes (not just requirements-gathering) for the product areas in scope.
• Keeps payments product decisions aligned with the bank's wider platform and commercial strategy.
• Maintains the quality of supplier and regulatory relationships built up over time.
• Elevates the payments function's credibility by clearly articulating the value and rationale behind prioritisation decisions.

Qualifications
• At least 5 years' product management experience, ideally in payments, fintech, or broader financial services.
• Proven track record of launching and managing successful digital products, with ownership of the detail as well as the bigger picture.
• Comfortable working closely with engineering teams; technical fluency (e.g. exposure to APIs, core banking platforms, or coding) is a strong advantage.
• Experience navigating supplier or partner relationships, and awareness of the compliance and regulatory considerations relevant to UK financial services.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across teams quickly.
• Experience with agile methodologies and tools such as JIRA or similar.
• Able to operate independently and make confident decisions in a fast-paced environment with imperfect information, important given the nature of stepping into a maternity cover role mid-flight.

Additional Information
Your Wellbeing - We take your health and well-being very seriously by providing a range of benefits to give you and your family peace of mind. These include:
• Market leading family friendly policies such as access to our Maternity, Adoption and Paternity policies from Day 1 of your employment
• Free access to Headspace, a mindfulness & meditation digital health app
• Free access to Peppy digital health app that offers personalised support through fertility treatment becoming a parent or menopause
• EAP (Employee Assistance Programme) - Offering you support on a wide range of subjects including financial concerns, mental wellbeing and more general queries around family, work, housing, and health

• Discounts on gym membership

• Discounts on gym membership nationwide
• Access to discounts on a range of high street and online brands

This role is responsible for driving operational excellence across the full financial lifecycle, from development and greenlight through delivery.
Reporting to the SVP, Production Finance, the VP will oversee freelance Production Finance Controllers across multiple international productions, and will serve as a key strategic partner to cross-functional stakeholders including Creative, Production, Business & Legal Affairs, and Corporate Finance.
The role requires strong leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to influence decision-making in a fast-paced, global production environment.  The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in production accounting along with experience operating within a corporate structure. They will ensure best-in-class financial practices, compliance with corporate policies, and disciplined cost management across productions.
As part of a globally distributed organization, with headquarters in Los Angeles and production in London, the U.S., and multiple other international locations (including Hungary, Australia, Spain, Canada, and Norway), this role requires exceptional communication and collaboration skills. The VP will partner closely with U.S.-based finance teams, particularly in Los Angeles, as well as regional production teams worldwide, navigating cultural and operational nuances effectively.
Occasional travel may be required to local and international offices.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership
•Strengthen strategic partnerships across Universal Studio Group to support and deliver on Production Slate objectives.
•Represent Production Finance leadership in senior forums, including deputizing for the SVP in leadership and Greenlight meetings.
•Maintain strong alignment and communication with U.S. based Production Finance and Production teams.
•Lead and manage freelance Production Finance Controllers, ensuring consistent application of financial standards and strong performance.
•Build and develop a high-quality pipeline of freelance Production Accounting talent aligned with NBCU practices.
Production Finance Strategy & Performance
•Develop and evaluate production finance plans, including multi-episode budgets, schedules, and cashflow models; provide recommendations to Greenlight Committees.
•Review and challenge production budgets and assumptions using benchmarks and internal comparables to assess risks and opportunities.
•Advise on tax credit strategies and implications, incorporating insights into Greenlight recommendations.
•Oversee financial performance of productions, including investments, revenues, cashflows, and loan activity, ensuring alignment with approved parameters.
•Monitor tax credit recoveries and revenue realization in coordination with auditors.
•Partner with NBCUniversal Treasury to manage foreign exchange exposure and execute FX strategies across international productions.

Your role as Plant Logistics Lead is to coordinate, regulate and monitor all aspects of warehouse management and distribution/transport management.
You will act as a contract manager and be the face of O-I with our 3PL’s.
You will be accountable for the receiving, documenting and temporary warehousing of packaging components, storage of finished goods and collection of empty returnable packaging from customers.

• A real drive to execute O-I’s commitment to on site H&S improvement on site.

• Strong people management, coaching and communication as well as proven leadership and team building
• Confidence influencing and negotiating across multiple functions
• The ability to thrive under pressure, managing complex operational scenarios, whilst always focussing on the quality of service and cost.
• The commitment to building a culture of continuous improvement
• Strong financial awareness and ability to manage budgets/P&L
• Strong IT knowledge for effective stock control and distribution
What You’ll Get
• The autonomy to deliver, manage and execute strategic objectives
• A competitive salary range of £40,000 - £45,000 dependant on experience
• 6% plant bonus dependant on individual and plant performance
• 33 days holiday including 8 bank holidays
• Employee Assistance Programme and Private Health Cover
• Life Assurance
• Highly competitive pension with minimum company contribution of 8% / employee minimum contribution 3%

Qualifications
• Operational experience in a comparable position in logistics / purchasing at site/plant level
• Experience in a matrixed organisation is desirable but not essential
• Experience with ERP systems such as SAP.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Care Team Leader to join our fantastic Care Team at Home Instead Down and Lisburn.

About This Job
The role
The Legal Technology Advisor (LTA) is an ambitious, analytical delivery specialist, passionate about digital transformation—including the practical use of Artificial Intelligence—who operates at the intersection of law and technology across One Europe. Embedded within designated Global Business Units (GBUs) throughout the region, the LTA collaborates with deal teams and litigation teams to implement technology solutions in real time, configuring tools during active matters to ensure seamless delivery. Acting as the bridge between client needs and Clifford Chance’s technology capabilities, the LTA scopes, advises on, and deploys technology-enabled solutions that improve efficiency, reduce risk, and contribute to revenue growth across European jurisdictions. This role drives adoption of the firm’s legal technology toolkit, delivers at the pace of client needs, and channels market and front-line insights from across One Europe to Product Management and Legal Technology Advisory leadership, helping to shape the firm’s innovation pipeline.
Key responsibilities
Delivery and Collaboration
• Act as the first point of contact for matter teams within the assigned GBU seeking technology‑enabled solutions; assess requirements, define scope and recommend appropriate tools and approaches.
• Design and deliver technology‑assisted workflows for live matters (e.g., document/contract review and analysis, due diligence, document automation, transaction management, litigation/eDiscovery, collaboration and workflow tools), ensuring high‑quality, compliant execution.
• Configure, integrate and optimise existing solutions to meet matter requirements; document functional requirements and enhancement requests; work with Product Management, IT and vendors on pilots and deployments.
• Identify and support power users of key legal technology solutions to help scale delivery capabilities across the GBU.
• Maintain clear documentation for solution configurations, matter playbooks and client engagement materials; share lessons learnt through the Legal Technology Advisory Community of Practice.
Client and Business Engagement
• Build strong relationships with partners and associates, serve as a trusted advisor and deliver at the pace of the client’s needs.
• Prepare and deliver tailored client‑facing demonstrations, proofs of concept and proposals that evidence value, differentiation and time‑to‑value.
• Support pricing and scoping of technology components in pitches, proposals and panel submissions, working with partners and commercial teams.
• Coordinate with relevant business stakeholders to embed legal technology into delivery and client strategies.
Strategic Insight and Market Awareness
• Monitor legal market trends, competitive activity and emerging technologies; identify process improvement opportunities and report local emerging technology solutions so they can be considered in the firm’s innovation pipeline.
• Capture and share success stories, usage insights and client feedback to inform go‑to‑market materials and the product roadmap.
• Balance immediate client demands with opportunities for broader business transformation, articulating practical, scalable solutions and change impacts.
Legal Technology Advisory
• Develop a deep understanding of lawyers' and clients' needs within the assigned GBU, promoting the benefits of the firm's legal technology toolkit and advising on optimal usage scenarios.
• Design, develop and apply technology solutions on-the-fly to support and deliver live matter work.
• Drive metrics‑driven adoption of existing solutions, prioritising engagement by demand, impact and readiness; address challenges collaboratively with Product Management teams.
• Assist with the introduction, deployment and communication of new solutions, focusing on end‑to‑end legal service delivery processes.
• Deliver tailored presentations and demos of the firm’s legal technology toolkit, including advanced specialist solutions and AI tools.
• Ensure solutions and workflows comply with firm policies, client requirements, data privacy and information security standards; identify delivery risks early and propose mitigations.
Committee and Group Participation
• Actively participate in the Legal Technology Advisory Community of Practice.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• Revenue generation directly attributable to the application of legal technology.
• Reduction in matter write-offs through improved efficiency and effective deployment of legal technology solutions.
• Success in winning client matters and panel appointments specifically due to demonstrated legal technology capabilities.
• Positive client feedback and satisfaction regarding technology-driven solutions and engagements.

Qualifications
Your experience
Skills:
• Demonstrable experience advising on and delivering legal technology within a professional services context (preferably legal or consulting).
• Hands‑on expertise across tools such as contract analysis and review platforms, document automation, transaction management, litigation/eDiscovery, workflow and collaboration solutions; strong familiarity with Microsoft 365 and the Power Platform is advantageous.
• Knowledge of AI and data‑driven solutions (including Generative AI, NLP and machine learning) and their practical application to legal workflows.
• Strength in requirements gathering, solution scoping, process mapping and change management; able to translate complex needs into practical, scalable solutions.
• Experience with Agile delivery practices and collaboration tools (e.g., Agile Central, JIRA); comfortable working with Product Management, IT and vendors.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to explain technical concepts in plain language and tailor style to partners, lawyers, clients and business stakeholders.
• High‑quality written communication skills, including preparation of internal communications, and client‑facing materials.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to manipulate data quickly and accurately; confident using metrics to drive prioritisation and decisions.
• Commercial awareness and insight into how legal technology impacts client outcomes and law firm economics.
• Proactive problem‑solver with entrepreneurial drive; able to manage multiple engagements, prioritise effectively and see initiatives through to completion.
• Credibility and intellectual rigour, with strong listening skills and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
• Confident, positive approach; comfortable interacting with individuals at all levels of the organisation.
Qualifications:
• Educated to degree level or equivalent experience.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are an advantage.
• Client‑facing interaction or consulting experience is a plus.

Hybrid working
This role follows our balanced hybrid working approach and as long as business needs allow, you will be supported to work

About This Job
THE ROLE (The Mission)
Your mission is to serve as the operational backbone of R&D Quality—administering, optimizing, and maintaining our electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) to ensure seamless GxP document control, comprehensive training compliance, robust CAPA management, and continuous inspection readiness across our clinical development programs.
• The Quality Management System (QMS) manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational administration, maintenance, and compliance oversight of the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) for R&D. The successful candidate will play a critical role in supporting the R&D Quality Assurance and Development Functional Area teams.
• This role will oversee GCP/GLP/GPV document control, manage GCP/GLP/GPV study training matrices, facilitate deviation/CAPA tracking, follow up on CAPAs through to completion, collect CAPA evidence of completion, and administer quality records to ensure continuous inspection readiness.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
1. eQMS Administration & GxP Document Lifecycle Control
• System Administration & Ownership: Act as the primary administrator, subject matter expert, and "go-to" operational contact for Bicycle’s validated electronic QMS (e.g., Veeva, TrackWise, Dot Compliance).
• Controlled Document Lifecycle Management: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle—including drafting, review workflows, electronic signatures, approval, distribution, periodic review, and obsolescence—of GxP Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), quality policies, work instructions, and clinical study templates in close partnership with functional authors.
• Document Integrity & Compliance: Maintain strict formatting, version control, and template adherence in compliance with internal style guides, regulatory documentation standards, and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
• Secure Archiving & Records Management: Coordinate the compliant, secure archiving and indexing of master controlled documents, superseded revisions, and historical quality records.
• Data Extraction & Process Reporting: Generate, extract, and analyze controlled document metrics to identify review bottlenecks, upcoming review milestones, and procedural gaps across R&D.
2. Training Management & Compliance Oversight
• Curriculum & Matrix Administration: Configure, deploy, and maintain study-specific and role-based GxP training curricula and matrices within the eQMS across clinical, non-clinical, and pharmacovigilance teams.
• Onboarding & Offboarding Workflows: Partner cross-functionally with Functional Area Leads, HR, and IT to ensure timely assignment, modification, and deactivation of training profiles for new hires, role transitions, and external contractors.
• Compliance Tracking & Escalation: Actively track training completion rates across global teams, follow up directly with users, provide automated compliance dashboards to line managers, and proactively flag overdue assignments to functional leadership.
• Personnel Qualification Records: Oversee the collection, review workflows, routine updates, and compliant archival of essential qualification documents, including CVs, Job Descriptions (JDs), and GxP training certificates.
3. Deviation, CAPA, and Quality Event Support
• Quality Event Logging & Workflow Support: Log, monitor, and facilitate the timely progress of clinical deviations, Quality Issues (QIs), and potential Serious Breaches through their defined eQMS workflows.
• CAPA Progression & Evidence Gathering: Track implementation milestones for Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), driving accountability with action owners and collecting verifiable evidence of completion prior to closure.
• Quality Trend & KPI Analysis: Extract, analyze, and compile quality performance data to populate periodic QA metrics and executive dashboards, helping uncover systemic process trends, repeat issues, or targeted training needs.
4. Audit & Inspection Readiness
• Audit Workflow Logistics: Support the administrative workflows for vendor assessments, internal audits, and clinical investigator site audits, tracking audit reports, observations, and audit responses through to closure.
• Inspection Room Operations: Provide pivotal administrative coordination and back-room support during sponsor regulatory authority inspections (e.g., FDA, MHRA, EMA) and partner audits.
• Rapid Record Retrieval: Rapidly locate, verify, and deliver essential clinical trial records, training histories, CVs, and system qualification logs requested by regulatory inspectors or auditors.
WHO ARE YOU: SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
Knowledge
• Core Expertise: Applies solid technical understanding of validated eQMS platforms (e.g., Veeva Vault, TrackWise, MasterControl), electronic document management principles, and GxP regulatory requirements (ICH GCP E6, GLP, GPV, and 21 CFR Part 11) to administer day-to-day R&D quality systems independently.
• Data / Insight: Accurately extracts, aggregates, and interprets eQMS metrics—such as SOP review cycles, training compliance rates, and CAPA resolution timelines—identifying meaningful patterns and presenting actionable findings to R&D teams.
• Influence & Collaboration: Communicates clearly and persuasively across global study teams, functional area leads, and external vendors/CROs, adapting style to explain compliance workflows, resolve user issues, and promote quality best practices.
Job Complexity
• Task / Project Delivery: Independently prioritizes and executes a diverse portfolio of operational tasks—including simultaneous document releases, study training rollouts, and CAPA tracking—managing competing timelines across fast-moving clinical trials.
• Problem-Solving: Addresses operational and system-related bottlenecks, such as workflow stoppages, formatting discrepancies, or lagging compliance, applying standard quality procedures and exercise of sound judgment to resolve issues efficiently.
• Strategic Impact: Directly underpins inspection readiness and data integrity across clinical development by maintaining accurate training records, transparent CAPA trails, and audit-ready document archives that protect trial credibility.
Independence
• Autonomy: Operates under general supervision with clearly defined quality objectives, executing day-to-day eQMS user management and document control tasks with high initiative and minimal oversight.
• Decision-Making: Makes sound operational decisions regarding document formatting compliance, workflow progressions, and training profile assignments within established quality parameters, knowing when to resolve matters directly and when to escalate compliance risks.
• Leadership / Mentorship: Provides friendly, accessible technical support and system training to eQMS end-users, mentoring less experienced colleagues on GxP documentation practices and continuous inspection readiness.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life®.
Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.
WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE
Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.
Job Responsibilities
The Senior Vice President (SVP), Clinical Development – Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care provides strategic, scientific, and operational leadership across global clinical development programs within the Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care (CMIC) therapeutic areas. This executive role is responsible for ensuring the successful delivery of complex, high-value studies across all phases, driving operational excellence, financial performance, innovation, and client satisfaction.
As a senior member of the Global Project Management leadership team, this individual shapes the organization’s therapeutic delivery strategy, ensures scientific and operational rigor, and fosters high-impact partnerships with clients and internal stakeholders. The SVP, CMIC acts as a trusted advisor and scientific authority within Cardiology, Metabolic Disorders, Critical Care, and related domains—bringing both credibility and vision to drive Syneos Health’s position as a market leader in these therapeutic areas.
Key Responsibilities:
Impact to the Organization
•
Directly influences Syneos Health’s success in the Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care therapeutic areas by ensuring delivery excellence, strengthening client partnerships, and driving innovation across clinical operations.
•
Serves as both a scientific authority and operational leader, shaping the future of clinical delivery and reinforcing Syneos Health’s reputation for excellence and leadership in the global CRO landscape.
Strategic Leadership
•
Develop and execute the strategic vision for Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care delivery, aligning clinical execution with corporate goals and client expectations.
•
Anticipate emerging trends and therapeutic innovations to position Syneos Health as the preferred partner in these therapeutic areas.
•
Drive organizational strategy for operational excellence, scalability, and delivery modernization.
•
Collaborate closely with senior leaders to align project delivery with enterprise objectives and strategic growth priorities.
Scientific Authority & External Influence
•
Maintain fluency in current and emerging clinical standards across cardiovascular, metabolic, and intensive care indications.
•
Act as a recognized thought leader—engaging in high-level discussions with client C-suites, regulatory stakeholders, and industry influencers.
•
Contribute to scientific and clinical development discussions, leveraging evidence-based insights to shape client strategies and partnerships.
•
Represent the company in scientific and industry forums to enhance visibility and credibility.
Therapeutic Portfolio Oversight
•
Provide executive oversight of all Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care projects from early to late development phases.
•
Ensure operational excellence, delivery performance, and proactive risk mitigation across the portfolio.
•
Establish and monitor governance frameworks for performance tracking, escalation management, and continuous improvement.
•
Partner cross-functionally with operational, scientific, and quality leaders to drive consistency and innovation in project delivery.
Executive Client Management & Business Development
•
Serve as the senior executive liaison for key strategic clients within the CMIC portfolio.
•
Partner with BD and functional teams to expand client relationships and identify growth opportunities.
•
Support high-stakes client engagements, including bid defenses, RFIs, and strategic presentations; coach senior leaders to do the same.
•
Cultivate long-term partnerships by demonstrating deep therapeutic expertise, strategic insight, and delivery excellence.
Financial & Operational Leadership
•
Maintain accountability for the financial health and performance of the CMIC therapeutic area.
•
Drive forecasting accuracy, portfolio profitability, and efficient resource utilization.
•
Collaborate with finance and operations leaders to ensure sustainable cost management and growth.
•
Champion data-driven decision making using operational analytics and performance metrics.
Organizational Leadership & Talent Development
•
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of global leaders (VP and below) within the CMIC therapeutic area.
•
Build a culture of collaboration, inclusion, empowerment, accountability, and continuous improvement.
•
Partner with HR and organizational leadership to strengthen succession pipelines and develop next-generation leaders.
Quality, Compliance & Continuous Improvement
•
Ensure compliance with ICH/GCP, regulatory standards, and internal quality systems.
•
Collaborate with quality leadership to drive inspection readiness and consistency across global operations.
•
Lead process improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, scalability, and client satisfaction.
•
Model a culture of quality and operational integrity across all delivery teams.
Qualifications
•
Advanced degree (MS, PharmD, MD, or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, or related scientific discipline required; Ph.D. preferred but not required.
•
Minimum of 15+ years of experience in clinical research, project management, or clinical operations within CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environments.
•
Extensive experience leading complex clinical development programs in cardiology, metabolic disorders, or intensive care indications.
•
Proven ability to manage large, global portfolios and lead multi-layered leadership teams.
•
Strong business acumen and financial management experience (budgeting, forecasting, P&L ownership).

A little bit more about us...
•
We believe in building a diverse and inclusive culture and positive employee experience.
•
We are One Team, more than just ourselves.

We are customer first, we understand, and help solve our customers’ problems.

We Test & Learn, we are empowered to learn and grow, unafraid of change.

• Help define the vision, roadmap, and priorities for content infrastructure capabilities.
• Translate business challenges into scalable technology solutions.
• Balance stakeholder requirements, business value, technical constraints, and operational impact when prioritising features and enhancements.
• Own business cases, product requirements, and release plans for capabilities under your remit.
• Provide strategic direction to the team, ensuring operational priorities remain aligned with the long-term product vision and transformation roadmap.
Transformation & Continuous Improvement
• Lead the team through organisational and technology change, ensuring successful adoption of new capabilities and processes.
• Create a culture of continuous improvement where team members actively identify and deliver efficiency opportunities.
• Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and optimise operational processes.
• Lead technology-enabled transformation initiatives across multiple business functions.
• Develop migration and adoption strategies for replacing legacy tools and processes.
• Drive measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, resilience, and user experience.
Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
• Build strong relationships across Product, Technology, Operations, Data Strategy, Risk, and Governance teams.
• Gather, assess, and prioritise stakeholder feedback to inform product decisions.
• Influence senior leaders and cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

Performance & Governance

Job Description:
Lead Cyber Security Engineer  | Beyond Trust, CyberArk
Competitive Salary + Benefits
Location: London / Staines / Salford Quays / Flexible
Permanent – Full time
We make health happen
At Bupa, we're here to help people live longer, healthier, happier lives. With no shareholders, we reinvest our profits into improving the health of our customers and the quality of the services we provide. As our IAM Lead Engineer, you will play a vital role in strengthening our security posture by leading the design, development and operation of identity and access management technologies across Bupa Global, India and UK (BGIUK).
Key Responsibilities
• Lead the design, configuration, integration and support of Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Electronic Identity Management (EIM) tools.
• Build custom workflows, connectors and automation to support efficient access provisioning.
• Integrate IAM solutions with core applications, Active Directory, Entra ID and cloud platforms.
• Troubleshoot IAM, access, authentication and identity-related issues.
• Implement least-privilege access, zero-trust principles and compliant access governance.
• Support audits and produce IAM evidence and reporting.
• Monitor platforms, respond to IAM-related incidents and manage remediation.
• Identify opportunities for automation and orchestration using PowerShell, Python and APIs.
• Collaborate with IT, Security, HR and business teams to deliver solutions that balance strong controls with smooth user experience.
• Lead and develop a high-performing IAM engineering team.
• Promote a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and security-first thinking.
What We’re Looking For
• Experience designing and operating IGA/PAM/EIM technologies (CyberArk, SailPoint, BeyondTrust, Saviynt etc.).
• Strong understanding of identity technologies (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, LDAP, Kerberos).
• Experience integrating IAM with cloud services (AWS, GCP) and on‑prem systems.
• Hands‑on experience with scripting (PowerShell, Python) and automation.
• Knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, MFA, SSO, federation and identity lifecycle.
• Understanding of AI use cases in IAM.
• 7+ years in cybersecurity or identity roles, 5+ years in IAM engineering leadership.
• Experience in regulated environments and large-scale enterprises.
• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA or IAM-specific qualifications.
• Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
Benefits
Our benefits are designed to make health happen for our people. Viva, our global wellbeing programme, supports mental, physical, financial, social and environmental wellbeing. We offer flexible working and a range of family‑friendly benefits.
Upon joining Bupa you will receive the following benefits and more:
• Private medical insurance
• Enhanced pension scheme
• Annual bonus scheme
• 25 days holiday + bank holidays
• Hybrid working options
Why Bupa
We’re a health insurer and provider. With no shareholders, our customers are our focus. Our people are all driven by the same purpose – helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. We make health happen by being brave, caring and responsible in everything we do.
We encourage all of our people to “Be you at Bupa”. We champion diversity and understand the importance of our people representing the communities and customers we serve. That’s why we especially encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
Bupa is a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. We aim to offer an interview to every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria. We’ll make sure you’re treated fairly and offer reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

Lloyd’s is the world’s leading insurance and reinsurance marketplace, bringing together the world’s leading risk takers to advance global progress.
Our strategy is focused on delivering strong underwriting performance, operating an efficient and flexible marketplace, and maximising the capital advantage of the Lloyd’s market — while continuing to build a Lloyd’s we are proud of.
How we deliver this, matters. We take the risk, make things happen, and own the outcome — working together across our global network to turn insight into impact.
We’re looking for a Head of Claims Oversight to lead how we oversee, challenge and strengthen claims performance across the Lloyd’s market.
This is a senior, influential role with the opportunity to shape how claims is viewed, managed and continuously improved across the market. You’ll bring insight, judgement and a clear focus on outcomes. You’ll build trusted relationships with senior market leaders, use data to identify emerging risks and know when to challenge, intervene or escalate.
And you’ll lead a team with the expertise and confidence to make a difference.
What you’ll be doing
You’ll lead our Claims Oversight team and help ensure managing agents deliver claims services that meet Lloyd’s expectations and support strong syndicate performance.
You’ll:
• Lead Principle 4, Claims Management, within our Principles Based Oversight framework.
• Identify and respond to emerging claims performance risks, taking proportionate action when needed.
• Use claims data and management information to turn insight into focused market action.
• Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across managing agents, brokers and market representative groups.
• Lead our day-to-day relationship with the LMA on claims matters.
• Lead the claims response for Lloyd’s Major Event Response activity.
• Work closely with Claims Operations, Claims Insight, Underwriting, Pricing, Reserving, Customer and Culture teams.
• Influence the development of Lloyd’s claims and performance management strategy.
• Lead, develop and empower a high-performing Claims Oversight team.
This is about more than identifying problems. You’ll help shape better outcomes for the market.
What you’ll bring
We’re looking for someone with strong claims expertise, sound judgement and the ability to influence at senior level.
You’ll bring:
• Significant claims experience gained in an operational, technical or oversight environment.
• Strong knowledge of claims management and risk, alongside experience of the insurance or wider financial services sector.
• An understanding of Lloyd’s, the London Market and international insurance markets.
• Experience working with senior stakeholders in complex organisations and navigating competing priorities.
• Evidence of influencing and negotiating challenging issues to reach effective outcomes.
• Experience leading and developing teams or subject matter experts.
• The ability to interpret complex information and turn it into clear, concise recommendations.
• Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills, with evidence of taking ownership through to delivery.
• Experience delivering business change or improvement.
You don’t need to approach every challenge in the same way. We value leaders who listen, adapt and bring different perspectives together to get to the right outcome.
The opportunity
Claims matters. It’s where the promise made through insurance becomes real.
In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to influence claims performance across the Lloyd’s market while helping us respond to major events and emerging risks.
You’ll challenge constructively. You’ll use evidence to focus attention where it matters. And you’ll give your team the confidence and space to use their expertise.
Our strategy is focused on strong underwriting performance, an efficient and flexible marketplace, and maximising the capital advantage of the Lloyd’s market.
Being inclusive at Lloyd’s is integral to how we work — and how we deliver impact.
We aim to build a diverse, inclusive environment that reflects the global markets we serve, where everyone is treated with dignity and respect and supported to reach their full potential.
We take the risk by challenging traditional thinking and being proactive about inclusion. That means being open and positive about workplace adjustments, prioritising health and wellbeing, and investing in diversity and inclusion training so everyone feels able to contribute and succeed.
We make things happen by turning our commitment into action. Through employee networks, mentoring, volunteering opportunities and sustained investment in professional development, we create an environment where inclusion is experienced day‑to‑day — not just talked about.
We own the outcome by focusing on impact. By bringing together diverse perspectives and the best minds in the industry, we work collaboratively with underwriters and brokers to create innovative, responsive solutions that share risk and solve complex problems across global markets.

• Preparing fee proposals to clients, including scoping discussions, pitch materials and internal engagement pricing committee memoranda;
• Pitching engagements and leading in business development initiatives; and
• Building relationships and maintaining direct contact with current and prospective clients.

The environment at Houlihan Lokey is multi-faceted and entrepreneurial and, as such, rewards Vice Presidents with substantial responsibility. • Prior structured product valuation or related experience

Your Impact
Leonardo is seeking an experienced customer-facing engineer to join the Integrated Sensing & Protection (ISP) Line of Business, supporting Leonardo's Precision Guidance portfolio, including SAL Seeker and Compact Seeker products.
Working as part of Leonardo's customer support and engineering community, you will provide specialist technical support to domestic and international customers throughout the integration, verification, validation, qualification and operational deployment of Precision Guidance systems.
This is a highly customer-facing engineering role requiring close collaboration with platform integrators, weapon system manufacturers and Leonardo engineering teams. The primary objective is to ensure customers achieve maximum value from integration and test activities while enabling the successful fielding and operation of Leonardo Precision Guidance products.
The role demands strong technical competence, systems thinking and excellent stakeholder engagement skills. You will frequently act as the technical bridge between customers and Leonardo's Precision Guidance development teams, helping to resolve integration challenges, support complex trials and identify opportunities for product improvement.
Regular UK and international travel will be required to support customer integration activities, trials, demonstrations and in-service support.
How you will support the ISP Precision Guidance business:
Precision Guidance Technical Support
• Acting as a technical focal point for customers integrating Leonardo Precision Guidance products, including SAL Seeker and Compact Seeker solutions.
• Providing specialist direction during system integration, verification, validation and acceptance activities.
• Advising customers on seeker performance, system interfaces, environmental considerations and operational capabilities.
• Supporting the resolution of technical issues encountered during integration, qualification and operational activities.

• Supporting customers in developing integration strategies and verification approaches.

• Participating in integration reviews, test readiness reviews and customer technical reviews.

• Helping customers establish meaningful test objectives, success criteria and evidence-based acceptance approaches.
• Identifying opportunities to improve integration efficiency, reduce programme risk and maximise test value.
Trials, Demonstrations and Operational Support

• Supporting the transition of Precision Guidance products from development into operational service.
• Assisting customers in understanding product capabilities, limitations and best practices for employment.

• Experience supporting the integration, verification and testing of complex defence or aerospace systems.
• Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and the system lifecycle.
• Experience working directly with customers and technical stakeholders.
• Ability to analyse technical problems and communicate solutions effectively.
• Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the UK and internationally.
• Ability to obtain and maintain appropriate UK security clearance.
Highly Desirable
• Experience of guided weapons, seekers, electro-optical systems or precision guidance technologies.
• Experience supporting weapons integration programmes.
• Familiarity with verification, validation and qualification processes.
• Experience supporting live trials, customer demonstrations or operational evaluation activities.
• Experience of safety management and risk assessments, including where associated with laser, outdoor working, machinery, airborne equipment.
• Experience in managing data collection, manipulation and analysis as part of facilitating successful tests and trials.
• Knowledge of military platforms and weapon system architectures.
• Experience working with international defence customers.

Elicit, analyse, and manage stakeholder and system requirements, ensuring traceability across the lifecycle.

Support verification and validation planning, ensuring requirements are testable and aligned to acceptance criteria.

Degree qualified in Systems Engineering, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
•
Good communication skills, able to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
•
Ability to work collaboratively within multi-disciplinary teams.
•
Experience working within multi-disciplinary teams on complex programmes.

Proven experience as a Systems Engineer within Defence or complex system environments with a strong understanding of systems engineering principles (i.e., MBSE) and lifecycle models (e.g. V-model, Agile, hybrid approaches).

Experience working across the systems engineering lifecycle, with a focus on requirements, architecture, and design phases.
•
Experience in requirements engineering, including elicitation, analysis, and management.
•
Ability to develop system architecture artefacts and design documentation, with an understanding of system integration concepts, interfaces, and dependencies.
•
Experience supporting integration and V&V activities, with an understanding of how designs translate into testable systems.

Familiarity with systems engineering standards (e.g. ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288).

Awareness of MOD frameworks and governance environments.

Understanding of requirements management and modelling tools (e.g. DOORS, SparxEA.

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join the PVD Engineering team, supporting the development, qualification, and continuous improvement of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
Working within a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will be responsible for the design and integration of electrical systems used throughout our PVD product portfolio. The role spans the full product lifecycle, from concept development and new product introduction through manufacturing support, customer installations, compliance activities, and field issue resolution.
This position offers the opportunity to work on complex equipment incorporating power distribution, machine safety systems, motion control, vacuum subsystems, process instrumentation, and equipment control architecture.

Safety & Compliance

• Develop and maintain documentation required to support compliance and certification activities.
Electrical Design & Development
• Design and develop electrical systems, assemblies, and control architectures for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
• Generate electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, bills of materials, and supporting engineering documentation.
• Support the integration of electrical hardware with mechanical, software, process, and systems engineering teams.
• Conduct design reviews and ensure designs meet functional, safety, reliability, and manufacturability requirements.
• Support product development activities from concept through qualification and release to manufacture.
Product Support & Continuous Improvement
• Investigate and resolve electrical issues affecting product performance, reliability, safety, manufacturing, or customer acceptance.
• Support root cause investigations and implementation of corrective actions.
• Drive product improvement initiatives focused on reliability, serviceability, cost reduction, and obsolescence management.
• Support field service and customer escalation activities where required.
Supplier & Manufacturing Support
• Work closely with suppliers to develop and qualify electrical assemblies and components.
• Support manufacturing teams with build issues, testing, and design improvements.
• Review and approve component substitutions and engineering changes.
Occasional domestic and international travel (up to 10%), including to the United States, may be required as part of this role
Minimum Qualifications
• Degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
• Experience in electrical design and development within an industrial, automation, capital equipment, or high-technology environment

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe.
